aglio-olio.desc: The simplest pasta full of garlic flavor.
aglio-olio.name: Aglio e Olio
steps: Boil 1 cup water, add 2 tsp salt, and cook spaghetti for 6 to 7 minutes. Reserve 1/2 cup (100ml) water and drain in a colander.
Slice Cheongyang chili thinly, and if using shrimp, season with salt and black pepper and pat dry with a paper towel.
Put 3 tbsp cooking oil and minced garlic in a cold pan and turn on the heat to low. Slowly stir-fry for 2 minutes until the garlic turns light brown. If it burns, it will taste bitter.
Add shrimp and sear both sides for 1 minute each, then add Cheongyang chili and stir-fry for 10 seconds.
Add spaghetti and 4 tbsp (60ml) water, then toss quickly over high heat for 1 minute so the oil and water emulsify nicely.
Sprinkle with black pepper and plate.
tips: Garlic must be cooked slowly over low heat so it doesn't burn.
The water combines with the oil to form a sauce, so make sure to add it.

air-fryer-goguma.desc: Sweet baked sweet potatoes made in the air fryer.
air-fryer-goguma.name: Air Fryer Baked Sweet Potato (Air Fryer Gun-goguma)
steps: Wash the sweet potato clean and wipe off the moisture.
Place them in the air fryer basket without overlapping.
Bake at 180 degrees for 30 minutes, flip them, and bake for 10 more minutes.
When a chopstick goes in easily, take them out and let them cool for 3 minutes.
tips: If the sizes vary, take the smaller ones out first.
Poking holes in the skin with a fork prevents them from bursting.

andong-gangodeungeo-gui.desc: Andong-style salted grilled mackerel infused with salt flavor.
andong-gangodeungeo-gui.name: Andong Salted Grilled Mackerel (Andong Gangodeungeo-gui)
steps: Split mackerel in half and wipe away moisture thoroughly with a paper towel.
Make 2 to 3 cuts on the skin side, sprinkle salt 1/2 tsp, and leave for 10 minutes.
Heat cooking oil 2 tbsp in a pan and cook from the skin side over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Flip and cook until golden brown for 4 more minutes.
tips: Reduce the salt for pre-salted mackerel.
It is a rice thief when placed on top of rice.

andong-geonjin-guksu.desc: Andong-style noodles served in anchovy broth.
andong-geonjin-guksu.name: Andong Geonjin-guksu
steps: Put anchovy and kombu in water 1.2 L, boil for 15 minutes, remove them, and season with soup soy sauce 2 tbsp.
Make egg garnish, cut into thin strips, cut Korean zucchini into thin strips, and stir-fry in cooking oil 1 tsp.
Boil thin wheat noodles, rinse in cold water, and drain.
Place noodles and toppings in a bowl, pour hot broth, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
tips: Geonjin-guksu means the noodles are lifted out and added to the broth.
Serve with seasoning sauce (soy sauce, Korean red pepper flakes, minced garlic).

anseong-jangteo-gukbap.desc: Anseong-style spicy beef soup with Korean radish and soybean sprouts served with rice.
anseong-jangteo-gukbap.name: Anseong Market Rice Soup (Anseong Jangteo Gukbap)
steps: Soak the beef in cold water for 15 minutes to draw out the blood, boil with Korean radish in water 1.5 L for 40 minutes, and shred the beef.
Cut the Korean radish into bite-sized pieces. Add Korean red pepper flakes, minced garlic, and soup soy sauce 2 tbsp to the broth and boil for 5 minutes.
Add the soybean sprout and boil for 5 minutes.
Place cooked rice, beef, and Korean radish in a bowl, pour the broth over, and top with green onion.
tips: Warming the rice in the hot broth first keeps it nice and warm.
Adding seonji makes it closer to the Daegu style.

apple-banana-salad.name: Apple Banana Salad
steps: Dice the apple with the skin on and slice the banana.
Mix 100 g of yogurt and 1 tbsp of mayonnaise to make the dressing.
Add the dressing to the fruit and toss.
Sprinkle with mixed nuts and serve.
tips: Soaking apples in sugar water and draining them slows down browning.
Toss just before eating.

apple-yogurt-salad.desc: A dessert and single meal of apples and nuts tossed in yogurt.
apple-yogurt-salad.name: Apple Yogurt Salad
steps: Wash the apple and dice it into 1cm sizes with the skin on.
Stir-fry the mixed nuts in a dry pan for 1 minute and crush them coarsely.
In a bowl, toss the apple with 150g of yogurt and 1 tsp of oligosaccharide syrup.
Place it in a bowl and top with the mixed nuts.
tips: Tossing the apple in yogurt right after cutting reduces browning.
The skin contains dietary fiber, so wash it thoroughly and eat it together.

asparagus-bacon-mal.desc: An appetizer of asparagus wrapped in bacon and pan-fried.
asparagus-bacon-mal.name: Asparagus Bacon Roll (Asparagus Bacon Mari)
steps: Cut off the tough bottom 2cm of the asparagus and gently peel the skin with a peeler.
Wrap the asparagus tightly with bacon and place it with the seam facing down.
Drizzle olive oil 1 tsp in a pan and cook over medium heat, rolling occasionally, until golden for 6 minutes.
Sprinkle with black pepper and serve.
tips: Bacon fat will render out, so use only a little olive oil.
Air frying at 190 degrees for 8 minutes is also good.

asparagus-shrimp-bokkeum.desc: A dish of shrimp and asparagus stir-fried with garlic.
asparagus-shrimp-bokkeum.name: Asparagus and Shrimp Stir-Fry (Asparagus Shrimp Bokkeum)
steps: Trim the bottoms of the asparagus and cut into 4cm lengths.
Drizzle olive oil 1 tbsp in a high-heat pan and sauté the minced garlic and shrimp for 1 minute.
Add the asparagus and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Season with salt 1/3 tsp and black pepper.
tips: Stir-fry briefly over high heat to keep it crisp.
Sprinkling lemon juice adds a refreshing taste.

avocado-egg-toast.desc: Brunch topped with mashed avocado and a fried egg.
avocado-egg-toast.name: Avocado and Egg Toast (Avocado Gyeran Toast)
steps: Toast sandwich bread in a dry pan over medium heat for 1 minute per side until crispy.
Remove the pit from avocado, scoop out the flesh with a spoon, mash with a fork, and mix in 1/4 tsp salt.
Drizzle 1 tsp cooking oil in a pan and fry egg for 1 minute 30 seconds until sunny-side up or soft-boiled.
Spread mashed avocado on sandwich bread, top with fried egg, and sprinkle with black pepper.
tips: Avocado is ripe and ready to eat when it yields slightly to gentle pressure.
Dropping a few drops of lemon juice can prevent browning.

avocado-yogurt-bowl.desc: A wholesome breakfast topped with avocado, yogurt, and mixed nuts.
avocado-yogurt-bowl.name: Avocado Yogurt Bowl
steps: Remove the skin and pit from the avocado and cut it into cubes, and slice the banana.
Put the yogurt in a bowl.
Top with the avocado and banana, and sprinkle with the mixed nuts.
Drizzle 1 tsp oligosaccharide syrup over the top and serve.
tips: Cut the avocado right before eating to minimize browning.
Omit the oligosaccharide syrup if you prefer less sweetness.

baby-banana-oat-bite.desc: Cookies naturally sweetened only with banana, without any sugar or butter.
baby-banana-oat-bite.name: Baby Banana Oatmeal Cookies (Ages 12M+)
steps: Mash the banana thoroughly with a fork in a bowl.
Add 40 g of oatmeal, mix, and let sit for 5 minutes.
Drop the batter by spoonfuls onto parchment paper to make 8 cookies, each 3 cm in diameter and 1 cm thick.
Bake in an air fryer or oven at 170°C for 12 minutes, then let cool.
tips: The riper the banana, the sweeter it is.
If they are too hard, slightly soften them in milk before eating.

baby-beef-broccoli-risotto.desc: A gentle risotto made with cooked rice.
baby-beef-broccoli-risotto.name: Beef and Broccoli Risotto for Babies (12+ months)
steps: Blanch only the florets of the broccoli and mince finely, and mince the beef finely as well.
Put 100ml of water and beef in a pot and boil for 5 minutes to cook.
Add the cooked rice and 80ml of milk, and simmer over low heat for 8 minutes while stirring.
Add the broccoli, simmer for 2 more minutes, and let it cool. Do not add any seasoning.
tips: Replace the milk with water if there is a milk allergy.
Add a tablespoon of water if it is too thick.

baby-beef-radish-soup.desc: A mild beef and radish soup served by soaking rice in a savory broth without seasoning.
baby-beef-radish-soup.name: Beef and Radish Soup (12 months and up)
steps: Remove the blood from the beef, mince finely, and slice the Korean radish thinly into 0.5 cm pieces. Mince the green onion very finely.
Put 300 ml of water and the beef in a pot, skim off the foam as it comes to a boil, and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes.
Add the Korean radish and simmer for 15 more minutes until tender and soft.
Add the green onion, boil for 2 minutes, and let cool. Do not season, and you can soak rice in it for the baby.
tips: Even if the broth is rich, do not add salt or soy sauce.
If the child has trouble eating it, mince the beef and Korean radish even smaller.

baby-beef-seaweed-juk.desc: A soft, slow-cooked porridge made with dried seaweed and beef.
baby-beef-seaweed-juk.name: Beef and Seaweed Rice Porridge for Babies (9+ Months)
steps: Soak the uncooked rice for 30 minutes and soak the dried seaweed for 5 minutes, then mince finely. Remove blood from the beef and mince finely.
Put the uncooked rice and 250 ml of water in a pot, bring to a boil, and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes.
Add the beef and dried seaweed and simmer for 10 more minutes.
Once thoroughly cooked, mash and let cool. Do not season.
tips: The dried seaweed must be minced finely so it is easy to swallow.
Test new ingredients starting with a small amount.

baby-beef-tofu-jorim.desc: Soft braised tofu without added sodium.
baby-beef-tofu-jorim.name: Braised Beef and Tofu (12+ months) (Beef Tofu Jorim)
steps: Cut the tofu into 1 cm cubes, and finely mince the beef, onion, and carrot.
Put 150 ml of water, beef, onion, and carrot into a pot and boil for 8 minutes.
Add the tofu and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes.
Cool before serving and do not add any seasoning.
tips: Around 12 months, omit seasoning or make it very bland.
Cook the beef thoroughly.

baby-beef-veg-jinbap.desc: Soft beef and vegetable soft rice for babies in the latter stage of weaning.
baby-beef-veg-jinbap.name: Beef and Vegetable Soft Rice for Babies (9+ Months)
steps: Wash the uncooked rice and soak for 30 minutes. Remove the blood from the beef, mince finely, and mince the carrot and Korean zucchini very finely into 0.3cm pieces.
In a pot, combine the soaked uncooked rice and 200ml water, bring to a boil, then reduce to low heat, cover with a lid, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the beef and carrot and cook for 10 minutes, then add the Korean zucchini and cook for 5 more minutes until very tender.
Mash with a spoon to a texture appropriate for your baby, let cool slightly, and serve. Do not season with salt.
tips: Introduce new ingredients one at a time, watching for reactions at 3-day intervals.
Portion and freeze any leftover soft rice and consume within 1 week.

baby-broccoli-cheese-omelet.desc: An egg dish rolled up with a savory slice of cheese.
baby-broccoli-cheese-omelet.name: Broccoli Cheese Omelet (Ages 12M+)
steps: Blanch the broccoli florets for 1 minute and mince finely. Tear the cheese into small pieces.
Beat 1 egg and 1 tbsp of milk thoroughly, and mix in the broccoli.
Lightly grease a pan over low heat with cooking oil, pour in the egg mixture, and cook for 2 minutes.
Top with the cheese, fold in half, cook thoroughly all the way through, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
tips: Cheese contains sodium, so use only a small amount.
Make sure the egg is cooked all the way through.

baby-chicken-broccoli-juk.desc: A soft porridge made with protein and vegetables.
baby-chicken-broccoli-juk.name: Chicken and Broccoli Rice Porridge (9 months and up)
steps: Soak the uncooked rice for 30 minutes. Boil the chicken breast in boiling water for 8 minutes until cooked through, then mince finely. Blanch only the florets of the broccoli, mince finely, and chop the carrot finely as well.
Put the soaked rice and 220 ml of water in a pot and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and carrot and simmer for 8 minutes, then add the broccoli and simmer for 4 more minutes.
Stir to adjust to the right consistency, cool, and serve. Do not season.
tips: Make sure to cook the chicken breast all the way through before mincing finely.
If you see allergic reactions (rash, vomiting), stop and consult a pediatrician.

baby-chicken-potato-soup.desc: A smooth soup made with chicken broth and mashed potato.
baby-chicken-potato-soup.name: Chicken Potato Soup for Babies (12+ months)
steps: Cut the potato and carrot into small pieces and mince the chicken breast finely.
Put 300ml of water and chicken breast in a pot, bring it to a boil, and simmer over low heat for 8 minutes.
Add the potato and carrot, and boil thoroughly for 12 minutes.
Mash the potato with a spoon to thicken the soup and let it cool. Do not add any seasoning.
tips: Cook the chicken all the way through and mince it finely.
Add a little more water if it is too thick.

baby-chicken-veg-bokkeumbap.desc: Toddler fried rice cooked without seasoning.
baby-chicken-veg-bokkeumbap.name: Chicken and Vegetable Fried Rice (12+ months) (Chicken Veg Bokkeumbap)
steps: Finely mince the chicken breast, carrot, and Korean zucchini to 5 mm.
Coat a pan with 1 tsp of cooking oil and sauté the chicken breast over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Add the carrot and Korean zucchini, stir-fry for 2 minutes, then add 3 tbsp of water, cover with a lid, and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the cooked rice, mix while breaking it up into small pieces, stir-fry for 2 minutes, cool, and serve.
tips: Chop the vegetables finely so the child can chew them easily.
No seasoning is needed.

baby-pumpkin-cheese-soup.desc: A smooth soup made with kabocha squash and milk.
baby-pumpkin-cheese-soup.name: Sweet Pumpkin Cheese Soup (12+ months) (Danhobak Cheese Soup)
steps: Peel the kabocha squash, cut it into chunks, and steam it in a steamer for 12 minutes until tender.
Put the kabocha squash and 200 ml of milk into a blender and blend until smooth.
Transfer to a pot, warm over low heat for 3 minutes, and add the cheese to melt.
Cool and serve.
tips: Check for milk allergies first.
It is good to use low-sodium baby cheese.

baby-pumpkin-chicken-juk.desc: A smooth chicken porridge with the natural sweetness of kabocha squash.
baby-pumpkin-chicken-juk.name: Sweet Pumpkin Chicken Porridge (Ages 12M+)
steps: Soak the uncooked rice for 30 minutes. Peel the kabocha squash and cut it small, and boil the chicken breast and mince it finely.
Put the uncooked rice and 250 ml of water in a pot, bring to a boil, and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes.
Add the kabocha squash and cook for 10 minutes, then add the chicken breast and cook for 5 more minutes.
Mash the kabocha squash to mix in and let cool. Do not season with salt.
tips: Make sure to cook the chicken breast all the way through before mincing finely.
If it is too thick, add 30 ml of water at a time.

baby-salmon-potato-mash.desc: A hearty meal of mashed salmon boiled without bones and potatoes.
baby-salmon-potato-mash.name: Salmon and Potato Mash (12 months and up)
steps: Peel the potato, cut into small pieces, and boil in boiling water for 10 minutes; remove bones and skin from the salmon and boil together for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Blanch the broccoli florets for 1 minute and mince finely.
Put the boiled potato and salmon in a bowl and mash finely with a fork. Check with your hands to ensure no bones remain.
Mix in the broccoli, let cool, and serve. Do not season.
tips: If feeding fish for the first time, start with a very small amount.
Be sure to check for bones twice.

baby-somyeon-soup.desc: Soft noodles cut into short lengths in an unsalted broth.
baby-somyeon-soup.name: Baby Somyeon Noodle Soup
steps: Cut the Korean zucchini and carrot into thin strips, and fry the beaten egg thinly into an egg garnish and slice it finely.
Boil 300 ml of water in a pot and cook the Korean zucchini and carrot for 5 minutes.

Cut the thin wheat noodles into bite-sized pieces (2 cm), boil them thoroughly for 6 minutes until soft, and rinse them. Since thin wheat noodles contain salt, it's better to boil and rinse them separately.
Place in a bowl, top with the egg garnish, and let it cool.
tips: Cut the thin wheat noodles short so they don't get caught in the throat.
Do not season the broth.

baby-spinach-beef-rice.desc: A soft bibimbap seasoned without soy sauce, using just a drop of sesame oil.
baby-spinach-beef-rice.name: Baby Spinach and Beef Rice (Baby Bibimbap)
steps: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 30 seconds, rinse in cold water, squeeze out the water, and mince finely. Mince the carrot finely as well.
Put the beef in 100 ml of water, boil for 5 minutes until cooked through, and mince finely.
Place the cooked rice in a bowl and top with the beef, spinach, and carrot.
Drizzle with 1/4 tsp (about 1 ml) of sesame oil and mix well so it is soft to eat.
tips: Blanch and finely mince the spinach so it's easy to eat.
Use only a tiny amount of sesame oil just for fragrance.

baby-sweetpotato-cheese-omelet.desc: A tender omelet with the natural sweetness of sweet potato.
baby-sweetpotato-cheese-omelet.name: Sweet Potato Cheese Omelet for Babies (12+ months)
steps: Cut the sweet potato into small pieces, microwave for 2 minutes to cook, and mash finely. Tear the cheese into small pieces.
Beat 1 egg and 1 tbsp of milk thoroughly, then mix in the sweet potato.
Coat a pan with cooking oil over low heat, pour in the egg mixture, cook for 2 minutes, place the cheese on top, and fold it in half.
Cook thoroughly all the way through, then cut into bite-sized pieces and let cool.
tips: Use only a small amount of cheese since it contains sodium.
The egg must be cooked completely.

baby-sweetpotato-pancake.desc: Baby pancakes baked with the natural sweetness of sweet potato without sugar.
baby-sweetpotato-pancake.name: Sweet Potato Oatmeal Pancake (12 months and up)
steps: Peel the sweet potato, microwave for 3 minutes to cook, and mash finely.
In a bowl, mix the mashed sweet potato, 20 g of oatmeal, 1/2 of an egg, and 2 tbsp of milk to make a batter.
Lightly grease a pan heated over low heat with cooking oil and drop 3 to 4 portions of the batter, each 4 cm in diameter.
Cook for 2 minutes and 30 seconds per side until cooked through, let cool, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
tips: If the heat is too high, only the outside will burn. Cook slowly over low heat.
If there is a milk allergy, substitute with water.

baby-tofu-beef-meatball.desc: Bite-sized, tender tofu and beef meatballs.
baby-tofu-beef-meatball.name: Tofu Beef Meatballs for Babies (12+ months)
steps: Squeeze the moisture out of the tofu, mash it finely, and mince the carrot very finely.
Mix the tofu, beef, carrot, and 1/2 of an egg together in a bowl.
Shape them into small 2 cm balls.
Lightly coat a pan with cooking oil over low heat, roll the meatballs around, cook them through for 6 minutes, and let them cool.
tips: Make sure to cook them completely through to the center.
Shape them small and cut them up when serving.

baby-tofu-egg-steam.desc: A soft protein side dish steamed without salt.
baby-tofu-egg-steam.name: Steamed Tofu and Egg (12 months and up)
steps: Mash the tofu finely with a spoon and mince the carrot very finely.
Beat 1 egg, mix with 50 ml of water, the mashed tofu, and the carrot, then strain once through a sieve.
Place in a small heat-resistant bowl, boil 300 ml of water in a pot, cover with a lid, and steam over low heat for 12 minutes.
Check that it is fully cooked through to the center, then let cool. Do not season.
tips: The egg must be cooked completely through to the center.
If an egg allergy has not been ruled out, start with a small amount.

baby-tofu-veg-patty.desc: Soft tofu and vegetable patties that are easy for little hands to hold.
baby-tofu-veg-patty.name: Tofu Vegetable Patties (Ages 12M+)
steps: Wrap the tofu in cheesecloth, squeeze out all the moisture firmly, and mash it finely. Mince the carrot and Korean zucchini very finely.
Combine the tofu, vegetables, 1/2 portion of the egg, and oatmeal in a bowl and mix into a dough.
Shape into 4 flat patties, 3 cm in diameter and 1 cm thick.
Grease a pan heated over low heat with cooking oil, cook for 3 minutes on each side until cooked through, and let cool.
tips: If the heat is too high, only the outside will burn. Cook slowly over low heat.
You do not need to add salt or soy sauce because the tofu has a nutty flavor on its own.

baby-veg-egg-riceball.desc: Bite-sized rice balls that are easy for little hands to pick up and eat.
baby-veg-egg-riceball.name: Toddler Veggie Egg Rice Balls (Ages 12M+)
steps: Mince the carrot and Korean zucchini very finely. Beat the egg.
Lightly grease a pan with cooking oil, sauté the carrot and Korean zucchini for 1 minute, add the egg to scramble, and mince finely.
Mix the cooked rice and the sautéed ingredients in a bowl.
Shape into 6 bite-sized balls (2.5 cm in diameter).
tips: Shape them small so the rice grains do not get stuck in the throat.
Serve them plain without coating in seaweed flakes.

baby-zucchini-beef-bokkeumbap.desc: A mild baby fried rice cooked without seasoning.
baby-zucchini-beef-bokkeumbap.name: Korean Zucchini and Beef Fried Rice for Babies (12+ months)
steps: Mince the Korean zucchini and carrot very finely.
Lightly coat a pan with cooking oil, stir-fry the beef for 2 minutes, then add the vegetables and stir-fry for 2 more minutes.
Add 2 tbsp of water and cooked rice, and stir-fry over low heat for 3 minutes.
Let it cool and shape it into bite-sized portions. Do not add any seasoning.
tips: Stir-fry until moist so the rice grains do not get stuck in the throat.
You do not need to top it with seasoned seaweed flakes.

baby-zucchini-egg-steam.desc: Soft steamed eggs with minced Korean zucchini.
baby-zucchini-egg-steam.name: Steamed Egg with Korean Zucchini (12+ months) (Korean Zucchini Gyeran-jjim)
steps: Finely mince the Korean zucchini.
Beat 2 egg, mix with 100 ml of water and the minced Korean zucchini, and strain through a sieve.
Pour into a heat-resistant bowl and steam in a steamer over low heat for 12 minutes.
Check if it is cooked through, let it cool slightly, and serve.
tips: Straining through a sieve makes it smooth.
Check first if there are any egg allergies.

bacon-cream-risotto.desc: Cream risotto made with bacon and milk.
bacon-cream-risotto.name: Bacon Cream Risotto
steps: Cut bacon into 1cm widths and mince onion.
Melt 1 tbsp of butter in a pan and sauté bacon and onion over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Add 300ml of milk and cooked rice, then simmer over low heat for 6 minutes while stirring.
Add cheese and 1/4 tsp of salt to melt, and sprinkle with black pepper.
tips: Since bacon releases oil, you can reduce the amount of butter.
If it looks a bit dry, add 2 tbsp of milk at a time.

bacon-tomato-pasta.desc: Tomato pasta combined with the savory flavor of bacon.
bacon-tomato-pasta.name: Bacon Tomato Pasta
steps: Add 1 tsp of salt to 1.5L of boiling water, cook spaghetti for 8 minutes, and reserve 1/2 cup (100ml) of water.
Cut bacon into 1cm pieces and mince onion.
Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a pan and sauté bacon, onion, and minced garlic over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Add pasta sauce and 3 tbsp of water, simmer for 2 minutes, add spaghetti, and toss for 1 minute.
tips: Sautéing the bacon until crisp brings out the flavor.
It tastes even better with grated cheese on top.

baechu-doenjang-guk.desc: A comforting soup combining the natural sweetness of napa cabbage with savory doenjang.
baechu-doenjang-guk.name: Napa Cabbage Doenjang Soup (Baechu Doenjang-guk)
steps: In a pot, combine water 700 ml and anchovy 10 g. Bring it to a boil, simmer over medium heat for 7 minutes, and remove the anchovy.
Cut the napa cabbage into bite-sized pieces and slice thinly the green onion.
Dissolve doenjang 1.5 tbsp through a strainer into the broth, add the napa cabbage, and boil for 8 minutes.
Add minced garlic and green onion, boil for 2 minutes, and turn off the heat.
tips: Dissolving the doenjang through a strainer keeps the broth clean.
Adding tofu or zucchini also goes very well with it.

baechu-geotjeori.desc: A crunchy napa cabbage salad meant to be eaten right away.
baechu-geotjeori.name: Fresh Napa Cabbage Salad (Baechu Geotjeori)
steps: Tear napa cabbage into bite-sized pieces, wash, and drain the water. Slice thinly green onion.
Mix Korean red pepper flakes 3 tbsp, minced garlic 1 tbsp, sugar 1 tbsp, soup soy sauce 2 tbsp, and green plum syrup 1 tbsp to make the seasoning.
Add the seasoning and green onion to napa cabbage and toss gently.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve right away.
tips: Toss it right before eating so it stays crunchy.
Once it wilts, it will release water, so only toss the amount you will eat in one sitting.

baechu-jeon.desc: A sweet and savory pan-fried dish made with thinly battered napa cabbage.
baechu-jeon.name: Napa Cabbage Pancake (Baechu-jeon)
steps: Detach the leaves of the napa cabbage one by one and gently press the thick white stem part with the back of a knife to flatten it.
In a bowl, mix Korean pancake mix 3 tbsp, water 5 tbsp (75 ml), and salt 1/4 tsp to make a light batter.
Coat the napa cabbage lightly with the batter, put cooking oil 2 tbsp in a pan heated over medium heat, and pan-fry until golden brown for 3 minutes on each side.
Serve with a dipping sauce made by mixing soy sauce 1 tbsp and vinegar 1/2 tbsp.
tips: If the stems are thick, they won't cook through, so you must press them flat.
If the batter is too thick, it gets chewy, so make it runny.

baesuk.desc: A warm dessert made by simmering Korean pear and ginger.
baesuk.name: Korean Pear Punch (Baesuk)
steps: Cut the top of the Korean pear like a lid and scoop out the core.
Slice the ginger thinly, put it inside the Korean pear, and fill with 2 tbsp of honey.
Place the Korean pear and 500 ml of water in a heat-resistant bowl and steam for 30 minutes in a steamer.
Enjoy it warm with the broth.
tips: The larger the Korean pear, the longer it needs to steam to become tender.
It is also good to steam jujubes along with it.

baguette-pizza.desc: Simple pizza made by topping a baguette with sauce and cheese.
baguette-pizza.name: Baguette Pizza
steps: Cut the baguette in half and brush with olive oil.
Spread the pasta sauce evenly and top with the onion and ham.
Top with the cheese.
Bake in an air fryer at 180°C for 6 minutes, or in an oven at 200°C for 8 minutes until the cheese melts.
tips: Toasting the edges first keeps them crispy.
Adding olives makes it taste more like pizza.

bajirak-kalguksu.desc: Knife-cut noodle soup with Manila clam broth and Korean zucchini.
bajirak-kalguksu.name: Manila Clam Knife-Cut Noodle Soup (Bajirak Kalguksu)
steps: Soak the manila clam in saltwater (500 ml of water with 1 tbsp of salt) for 30 minutes to purge grit, then scrub the shells clean.
Put 800 ml of water and manila clam in a pot and boil; when the shells open, take them out.
Cut the Korean zucchini into thin strips, slice the onion thinly, shake the knife-cut wheat noodles, and put them in the broth to boil for 5 minutes.
Add the Korean zucchini, onion, minced garlic, 1 tbsp of soup soy sauce, and salt to boil for 3 minutes, then add the manila clam and green onion to boil for 1 minute more.
tips: The flour on the noodles makes the broth thick. Shake it off before adding.
Do not eat any manila clam that does not open its shell.

bajirak-sulchim.desc: Manila clam steam with a refreshing broth infused with rice wine.
bajirak-sulchim.name: Steamed Manila Clams in Rice Wine (Bajirak-sulchim)
steps: Desalinate the manila clam in salt water for 30 minutes, wash them, and slice thinly the Cheongyang chili and green onion.
In a pot, add the manila clam, 3 tbsp mirin, minced garlic, and 100 ml water, cover with a lid, and boil over high heat.
Once the shells open, cook for 1 minute more over low heat.
Top with the Cheongyang chili and green onion.
tips: Discard any clams that do not open.
It is also great to add noodles or rice into the broth.

bajirak-sundubu.desc: A refreshing soft tofu stew with manila clam broth.
bajirak-sundubu.name: Clam Soft Tofu Stew (Bajirak Sundubu Jjigae)
steps: Soak manila clam in saltwater for 30 minutes to purge sand and slice thinly green onion.
In a pot, stir-fry 1 tbsp cooking oil, 1 tbsp Korean red pepper flakes, and minced garlic over low heat for 1 minute.
Add 300ml water and manila clam, and boil for 4 minutes until the shells open.
Scoop in soft tofu in large chunks, season with 1 tsp soup soy sauce, boil for 5 minutes, then crack in egg and top with green onion.
tips: Manila clam has a salty taste, so check the seasoning at the end.
Turn off the heat 30 seconds after adding the egg to make it soft-boiled.

baksok-nakji-tang.desc: A refreshing small octopus soup made with thinly sliced Korean radish.
baksok-nakji-tang.name: Clear Small Octopus Soup (Baksok Nakji-tang)
steps: Scrub the small octopus with salt to wash it, and slice the Korean radish thinly and broadly.
In a pot, add water 900 ml and Korean radish, and boil for 12 minutes.
Season with minced garlic, soup soy sauce 1 tbsp, and salt 1/3 tsp, and boil for 3 more minutes.
Add the small octopus, green onion, and Cheongyang chili, boil for only 1 minute and 30 seconds, and serve immediately.
tips: Cook the small octopus only briefly at the end so it stays tender.
The Korean radish determines the flavor, so use a sweet one.

bam-bap.name: Chestnut Rice (Bam-bap)
steps: Wash and soak the uncooked rice for 30 minutes, peel the chestnut, and split them in half.
Put the uncooked rice, 290 ml of water, and 1/3 tsp of salt in a pot, and top with the chestnut.
Bring to a boil over high heat, cook over low heat for 15 minutes, turn off the heat, and let steam for 10 minutes.
Make a seasoned soy sauce with 2 tbsp of soy sauce, slice thinly green onion, sesame oil, and sesame seeds to serve on the side.
tips: Split the chestnut into large pieces for a better texture.
You can also add jujubes together.

banana-oat-pancake.desc: Pancakes baked with banana, oatmeal, and egg without flour.
banana-oat-pancake.name: Banana Oatmeal Pancake
steps: Mash the banana finely in a bowl with a fork.
Add 1 egg and 30g of oatmeal, mix, and let it sit for 5 minutes.
Apply a thin layer of 1 tsp of cooking oil on a pan heated over low heat using a paper towel.
Divide the batter into 3 to 4 portions with a spoon and cook each side until golden for 2 minutes.
tips: If the heat is too high, only the outside will burn. Keep the heat low.
The riper the banana, the sweeter it is, so sugar is not needed.

banana-popsicle.desc: Banana milk popsicles made without sugar.
banana-popsicle.name: Banana Milk Popsicle
steps: Peel the banana and place it in a blender.
Add 200 ml of milk and yogurt, and blend until smooth.
Pour evenly into popsicle molds or small cups.
Freeze in the freezer for at least 4 hours.
tips: Using ripe bananas makes them sweet even without sugar.
When removing from the mold, dip it briefly in lukewarm water.

bean-sprout-soup.desc: A refreshing soup that is also great for hangovers.
bean-sprout-soup.name: Soybean Sprout Soup (Kongnamul-guk)
steps: Lightly rinse the soybean sprout in running water, drain in a colander, and slice the green onion thinly on a diagonal.
Put the soybean sprout and water 600ml in a pot, cover with a lid, and boil over medium heat. Do not open the lid while boiling, as it will cause a grassy smell.
Once it comes to a boil, boil for 7 minutes more. They are done when the heads of the soybean sprout become translucent.
Season with minced garlic, salt 1 tsp, and soy sauce 1 tsp, then add the green onion and boil for 1 minute more.
tips: Adding 1/2 tsp (about 1g) of Korean red pepper flakes makes a spicy soybean sprout soup.
Adding 1/2 cup (about 50g) of kimchi to boil makes kimchi and soybean sprout soup.

beef-bokkeumbap.desc: Fried rice stir-fried with beef, vegetables, and soy sauce.
beef-bokkeumbap.name: Beef Fried Rice (So-gogi Bokkeumbap)
steps: Finely mince the beef, onion, and carrot, and slice the green onion thinly.
Heat cooking oil 1 tbsp in a pan over high heat, sauté the green onion for 30 seconds and the beef for 2 minutes.
Add the onion and carrot and sauté for 1 minute, then add the cooked rice along with soy sauce 1 tbsp and oyster sauce 1/2 tbsp and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Drizzle with sesame oil to finish.
tips: Using cold leftover rice gives the fried rice a nice, separated texture.
Pour the soy sauce around the edge of the pan to give it a smoky flavor.

beef-doenjang-jjigae.desc: A savory soybean paste stew made with beef and Korean zucchini.
beef-doenjang-jjigae.name: Beef Soybean Paste Stew (Beef Doenjang Jjigae)
steps: Dice beef, tofu, Korean zucchini, and onion into 1.5cm cubes, and slice thinly green onion.
Pour 500ml water into an earthenware pot and dissolve 2 tbsp doenjang to boil.
When it boils, add beef, onion, minced garlic, and Korean red pepper flakes and boil for 5 minutes.
Add Korean zucchini and tofu, boil for 5 more minutes, and then add green onion.
tips: Sifting doenjang through a strainer makes the broth clean.
Stir-frying beef in sesame oil first makes it more nutty.

beef-gaji-bokkeum.desc: A dish of tender eggplant and beef stir-fried with soy sauce.
beef-gaji-bokkeum.name: Stir-Fried Beef and Eggplant (Beef Gaji Bokkeum)
steps: Cut eggplant into bite-sized pieces and cut onion into thin strips. Cut beef into bite-sized pieces.
Heat 1 tbsp of cooking oil in a pan over high heat and stir-fry beef and minced garlic for 2 minutes.
Add eggplant and onion, and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Add 1 tbsp of soy sauce and 1 tbsp of oyster sauce, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
tips: Eggplant absorbs a lot of oil, so stir-fry quickly over high heat.
Adding cheongyang pepper makes it spicy and kicky.

beef-jangjorim.name: Soy-Braised Beef (Beef Jangjorim)
steps: Soak the beef in cold water for 30 minutes to draw out the blood, then boil it with the green onion in 600ml of water for 40 minutes. Boil the quail egg and peel the shells.
Take out the boiled meat, tear it along the grain, and leave only 400ml of the broth.
Add 5 tbsp of soy sauce, 1 tbsp of sugar, and 2 tbsp of mirin to the broth and bring to a boil.
Add the torn meat and quail egg, and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes.
tips: It develops a deep flavor when simmered in the broth used to boil the meat.
Keep it refrigerated and it will last for a week.

beef-juk.desc: A savory porridge simmered with beef and sesame oil.
beef-juk.name: Beef Porridge (Beef Juk)
steps: Soak uncooked rice for 30 minutes and finely mince beef and carrot.
Drizzle 1 tbsp of sesame oil in a pot, stir-fry beef for 1 minute, add uncooked rice, and stir-fry for 1 more minute.
Pour in 1 L of water and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes while stirring.
Add carrot and 1 tbsp of soup soy sauce, and simmer for 5 more minutes.
tips: Stir-frying the uncooked rice before boiling makes the porridge extra nutty and savory.
Stir frequently to prevent it from sticking to the bottom.

beef-jumeokbap.desc: Bite-sized rice balls filled with savory soy sauce beef.
beef-jumeokbap.name: Beef Rice Balls (So-gogi Jumeokbap)
steps: Mince the beef finely and toss it with soy sauce 1 tbsp and sugar 1 tsp.
Sauté the beef in a heated pan over medium heat for 3 minutes, then let it cool.
Mix the cooked rice with sesame oil 1 tbsp, sesame seeds, and the cooked beef, then crumble in roasted seaweed and shape into bite-sized balls.
Let them cool slightly and place on a plate or wrap in plastic wrap.
tips: Shape the rice while it's hot so it holds together well.
Rub a little sesame oil on your hands so the rice doesn't stick.

beef-mushroom-jeongol.desc: A clear hot pot filled with beef, mushroom, and glass noodles.
beef-mushroom-jeongol.name: Beef and Mushroom Hot Pot (Beef Mushroom Jeongol)
steps: Soak glass noodles in cold water for 30 minutes, cut napa cabbage and onion into thin strips, and tear mushroom into bite-sized pieces.
Marinate beef with 2 tbsp of soy sauce and minced garlic for 10 minutes.
Arrange vegetable, mushroom, and beef in a hot pot, and pour in 800 ml of water and 1 tbsp of soup soy sauce.
When it starts to boil, add glass noodles and green onion and boil for 5 more minutes.
tips: Adding meat marinated in seasoning makes the broth richer.
You can also add kalguksu (knife-cut noodles) at the end.

beef-radish-soup.desc: A clear beef soup with the sweet flavor of radish.
beef-radish-soup.name: Beef and Radish Soup (Sogogi-mu-guk)
steps: Cut the Korean radish into 2cm flat pieces, blot the blood from the beef with a paper towel, and slice the green onion diagonally.

Drizzle 1 tbsp of sesame oil in a pot, stir-fry the beef over medium heat for 2 min, then add the Korean radish and stir-fry for 3 more min. It is ready when the surface of the radish becomes translucent.
Pour 800ml of water, and when it boils over high heat, reduce to medium-low heat and simmer for 20 min. Skim off the foam.
Season with 2 tbsp of soup soy sauce and minced garlic, and boil for 5 more min.
Add the green onion and finish with 1/3 tsp of salt.
tips: The radish is fully cooked when it becomes translucent and a chopstick goes through easily.
The longer it boils, the deeper the broth becomes.

beef-seaweed-soup.desc: A hearty soup that is too good to eat only on birthdays.
beef-seaweed-soup.name: Beef Seaweed Soup (Miyeok-guk)
steps: Soak the dried seaweed in cold water for 20 minutes, rinse twice under running water, squeeze out the water, and cut into bite-sized pieces with kitchen shears.

Add 1 tbsp of sesame oil to a pot and stir-fry the beef over medium heat for 2 minutes; once the surface is cooked, add the dried seaweed and stir-fry for 3~4 minutes longer until the dried seaweed turns a deep green and glossy.
Pour in 800ml of water, bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to medium-low heat and simmer for 20 minutes while skimming off any foam that rises to the top.
Season with 1.5 tbsp of soy sauce and minced garlic, and add 1 pinch of salt if it needs more flavor, then simmer for 5 minutes longer.
tips: The longer you simmer it, the milkier and richer the broth becomes, and 30 minutes or more is totally fine.
You can substitute canned tuna (drained 85g) for the beef for a savory flavor.

beef-ssalguksu.desc: An easy-to-make rice noodle soup topped with a generous amount of mung bean sprouts.
beef-ssalguksu.name: Beef Rice Noodle Soup (Beef Ssalguksu)
steps: Soak rice noodles in lukewarm water for 20 min. Put water 800 ml and anchovy 10 g in a pot, boil for 7 min, and remove the anchovies.
Add soy sauce 1 tbsp, sugar 1 tsp, salt 1/3 tsp, and sliced onion to the broth and boil for 3 min.
Add beef and boil for 1 min until the meat loses its pink color, then remove the meat. Add soaked rice noodles to the broth and boil for 2 min.
Put rice noodles in a bowl, top with beef, mung bean sprout, and sliced green onion, pour hot broth over it, and sprinkle with black pepper.
tips: Mung bean sprouts get cooked just enough from the heat of the hot broth.
Serve with cilantro or lime if available.

beef-steak.desc: A pan-seared steak basted with butter.
beef-steak.name: Beef Steak (Sogogi Steak)
steps: Take beef out 30 minutes before cooking to bring it to room temperature, wipe away moisture with a paper towel, and season with 1/3 tsp of salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp of cooking oil in a pan over high heat, place beef in, sear for 2 minutes and 30 seconds, flip, and sear for 2 more minutes.
Reduce heat to medium, add 1 tbsp of butter and minced garlic, and baste beef with the melted butter using a spoon while searing for 1 minute to finish.
Place on a plate, let it rest for 5 minutes, and slice.
tips: Heat the pan thoroughly before cooking so the surface gets nicely browned.
Resting prevents the juices from escaping.

beef-veg-bokkeum.desc: Various vegetables and beef stir-fried in oyster sauce.
beef-veg-bokkeum.name: Stir-Fried Beef and Vegetables
steps: Marinate the beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp mirin, minced garlic, and black pepper for 10 minutes. Cut the onion and bell pepper into 1 cm-wide strips, tear or slice the mushroom, and slice the green onion diagonally.
Heat a pan over high heat, add 1 tbsp cooking oil, and stir-fry the beef for 2 to 3 minutes; remove it once the outside is cooked.
In the same pan, stir-fry the onion and green onion for 1 minute, and the bell pepper and mushroom for 2 minutes over high heat. Lower the heat when the vegetables are crisp.
Add the beef back in along with the remaining 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1/2 tbsp oyster sauce, and 1/2 tbsp sugar, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Turn off the heat, drizzle with 1 tsp sesame oil, and mix.
tips: Stir-fry vegetables quickly over high heat to keep them crisp.
You can use pork or chicken breast instead of beef.

beet-salad.desc: A brightly colored salad made with boiled beet and iceberg lettuce.
beet-salad.name: Beet Salad
steps: Boil the beet with skin on in boiling water for 20 minutes, cool, peel, and cut into cubes.
Tear the iceberg lettuce into bite-sized pieces and drain well.
Mix olive oil 1 tbsp, vinegar 1 tbsp, oligosaccharide syrup 1 tbsp, and salt 1/4 tsp to make the dressing.
Place the iceberg lettuce and beet on a plate, and top with the dressing and mixed nuts.
tips: Beets stain easily, so it is convenient to place plastic wrap on the cutting board before slicing.
They also taste delicious when roasted in the air fryer because it brings out their sweetness.

beoseot-jeon.desc: A light and savory mushroom pancake made with batter.
beoseot-jeon.name: Pan-Fried Mushrooms (Beoseot Jeon)
steps: Tear the mushroom into bite-sized pieces, season with 1/4 tsp of salt, and let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix 4 tbsp of Korean pancake mix, 2 eggs, and 3 tbsp of water to make a batter.
Toss the mushroom in the batter.
Heat a pan over medium heat, add 2 tbsp of cooking oil, drop by spoonfuls, and pan-fry for 2 minutes and 30 seconds on each side.
tips: Pat the mushroom dry with paper towels for extra crispiness.
Serve with soy-vinegar dipping sauce.

beoseot-sotbap.desc: Fragrant pot rice cooked with various mushrooms on top.
beoseot-sotbap.name: Mushroom Clay Pot Rice (Beoseot Sotbap)
steps: Wash uncooked rice and soak for 30 minutes. Tear or cut mushroom into bite-sized pieces.
In a pot, add uncooked rice, water 290ml, soy sauce 1 tbsp, and mirin 1 tbsp, and place mushroom on top.
Bring to a boil over high heat, cook on low heat for 12 minutes, turn off the heat, and let steam for 10 minutes.
Mix the remaining soy sauce 1 tbsp, sesame oil 1 tbsp, and slice thinly green onion to mix and eat with.
tips: Do not wash mushroom in water for too long, just shake lightly before using.
Mixing different varieties deepens the flavor.

bibim-dangmyeon.desc: Chewy glass noodles tossed in a sweet and sour sauce.
bibim-dangmyeon.name: Bibim Dangmyeon
steps: Boil glass noodles in boiling water for 7 minutes, rinse in cold water, and drain.
Cut cucumber and carrot into thin strips.
Mix gochujang 2 tbsp, Korean red pepper flakes 1/2 tbsp, vinegar 1 tbsp, sugar 1 tbsp, soy sauce 1 tbsp, and sesame oil 1 tbsp to make the sauce.
Add the sauce to the glass noodles and vegetables, toss, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
tips: Tossing the boiled glass noodles with a drop of sesame oil first prevents them from sticking.
Toss right before eating so they do not get soggy.

bibim-naengmyeon.desc: Cold noodles mixed with a sweet and spicy sauce.
bibim-naengmyeon.name: Spicy Cold Noodles (Bibim-naengmyeon)
steps: Mix gochujang 2 tbsp, Korean red pepper flakes 1 tbsp, vinegar 2 tbsp, sugar 1 tbsp, soy sauce 1 tbsp, minced garlic, and sesame oil 1 tbsp to make the sauce, then store it in the refrigerator.
Boil naengmyeon noodles, rinse vigorously in cold water, and squeeze out the water.
Cut the cucumber and Korean pear into thin strips, and boil the egg and cut it in half.
Add the sauce to naengmyeon noodles, mix well, and top with the garnishes.
tips: Making the sauce ahead of time and letting it age deepens the flavor.
Blending Korean pear into the sauce adds natural sweetness.

bibim-noodles.desc: A sweet, sour, and spicy bowl of noodles.
bibim-noodles.name: Spicy Mixed Noodles (Bibim Guksu)
steps: Boil 2 L of water in a large pot, put the egg into cold water, boil for 10 minutes after it starts boiling, cool in cold water, peel the shell, and cut in half.
Mix 2 tbsp of gochujang, 1 tbsp of vinegar, 1 tbsp of sugar, 1 tbsp of soy sauce, and 1 tbsp of sesame oil to make the sauce, and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Put the thin wheat noodles into the boiling water and boil for 4 minutes, pouring in 1 cup (200 ml) of cold water whenever bubbles rise to the top.
Rinse the boiled thin wheat noodles 3 to 4 times while rubbing them in cold water to remove the starch, drain well in a colander, as leaving moisture will make the sauce watery.
Cut the kimchi and cucumber into thin strips, add them along with the thin wheat noodles to the sauce, and mix well, then top with the egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds to finish.
tips: You must wash the noodles vigorously in cold water so they stay chewy.
If you dislike spicy food, reduce gochujang to 1.5 tbsp and add 1/2 tbsp more sugar.

bibimbap.desc: A classic rice bowl topped with seasoned vegetables and an egg, mixed with gochujang.
bibimbap.name: Bibimbap
steps: Put the soybean sprout in a pot with water 100ml, cover with a lid, steam for 5 minutes, remove, and toss with salt 1/6 tsp and sesame oil 1/2 tsp. Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 30 seconds, squeeze out the moisture, and toss with minced garlic, salt 1/6 tsp, and sesame oil 1/2 tsp.
Cut the carrot and Korean zucchini into thin strips 3mm thick, stir-fry them separately in a pan with cooking oil for 1~2 minutes each, and sprinkle a pinch of salt on each.
In the same pan, coat with a very small amount of cooking oil and fry the egg for 1 minute 30 seconds to make a soft-boiled egg.
Put cooked rice in a bowl, arrange the seasoned vegetables by color around the edge, and place the egg in the center.
Top with gochujang 1 tbsp, sesame oil, and sesame seeds, then mix everything together to eat.
tips: Seasoning the vegetables separately keeps their flavors distinct even when mixed.
You can also mix it with soy sauce 1 tbsp and sesame oil instead of gochujang for a cleaner, milder taste.

blueberry-oat-bowl.desc: A morning breakfast of oatmeal soaked in milk and topped with blueberries.
blueberry-oat-bowl.name: Blueberry Oatmeal Bowl
steps: Pour 200 ml of milk over the oatmeal and microwave for 2 minutes.
Transfer to a bowl and top with the blueberry.
Sprinkle with mixed nuts, drizzle 1 tsp of honey, and serve.
Eat it right away while it's warm.
tips: Soaking it in the refrigerator overnight makes overnight oats.
Frozen blueberries are fine too.

blueberry-pancake.name: Blueberry Pancake
steps: Mix the flour, sugar, egg, and milk together leaving some lumps.
Gently fold the blueberry into the batter.
Melt the butter in a pan over low heat and ladle the batter in.
Flip when bubbles appear and cook for 1 minute 30 seconds more.
tips: Fold the blueberry gently so they don't burst.
Honey is a good substitute for maple syrup.

boiled-egg-salad.desc: A salad of boiled eggs and fresh vegetables tossed in a tangy soy sauce dressing.
boiled-egg-salad.name: Boiled Egg Vegetable Salad
steps: Put egg and water 600ml in a pot and boil on high heat. When it boils, reduce to medium heat, boil for 10 minutes, cool in cold water, peel the shell, and cut into quarters.
Tear iceberg lettuce into bite-sized pieces by hand, cut tomato into wedges, and cut cucumber into half-moons.
Make the dressing by mixing soy sauce 1 tsp, vinegar 1 tbsp, oligosaccharide syrup 1 tsp, sesame oil 1 tsp, and black pepper.
Arrange vegetables on a plate, top with egg, and drizzle the dressing.
tips: Starting to boil the egg in cold water makes it easier to peel.
Pour the dressing just before eating so the vegetables do not get soggy.

bokchoy-shrimp-bokkeum.desc: A dish of crisp bok choy and shrimp stir-fried in oyster sauce.
bokchoy-shrimp-bokkeum.name: Bok Choy and Shrimp Stir-Fry
steps: Separate the leaves of the bok choy, wash them, and cut large ones in half.
Heat 1 tbsp of cooking oil in a pan over high heat and stir-fry the minced garlic and shrimp for 1 minute and 30 seconds.
Add the bok choy and 1 tbsp of oyster sauce, stir-fry quickly for 1 minute and 30 seconds, and sprinkle with black pepper.
Transfer to a plate and serve immediately.
tips: Stir-fry quickly over high heat to keep it crisp.
Squid works well instead of shrimp.

bossam.desc: Boiled pork wraps served with napa cabbage.
bossam.name: Bossam
steps: Add doenjang, green onion, and ginger to water 1.5L, and when it boils, add the pork, boil for 50 minutes, remove, and let cool.
Cut the Korean radish into thin strips and toss with Korean red pepper flakes 2 tbsp, vinegar 1 tbsp, and sugar 1 tbsp to make seasoned radish salad.
Blanch the napa cabbage in boiling water for 1 minute, rinse in cold water, and drain.
Slice the pork thickly and serve with napa cabbage, seasoned radish salad, and ssamjang.
tips: Blanching the napa cabbage brings out its natural sweetness.
You can also blanch the napa cabbage in the water used to boil the pork.

braised-tofu.desc: The easiest tofu side dish for everyday meals.
braised-tofu.name: Braised Tofu (Dubu-jorim)
steps: Cut the tofu into 1cm thick slices and leave them on paper towels for 5 minutes to remove excess moisture. Slice the onion thinly and slice the green onion thinly.
Heat a pan over medium heat with 1 tbsp of cooking oil, place the tofu without overlapping, and pan-fry each side for 3 minutes until golden brown, then transfer to a plate.
In a bowl, mix 3 tbsp of soy sauce, 1 tbsp of Korean red pepper flakes, 1 tsp of minced garlic, 1 tsp of sugar, and 100ml of water to make the sauce.
Place the pan-fried tofu back in the same pan, top with the onion and green onion, and pour the sauce evenly over them.
Simmer over medium-low heat for 8~10 minutes, spooning the sauce over the tofu as it cooks. It is done when about 1/3 of the broth is left.
Turn off the heat and sprinkle with 1 tsp of sesame oil and sesame seeds.
tips: Pan-frying the tofu first prevents it from breaking apart and makes it chewy when braised.
If the seasoning is too strong, adjust by adding 2 tbsp (30ml) more water.

bread-pizza.desc: A simple pizza baked on top of sandwich bread.
bread-pizza.name: Bread Pizza (Sikppang Pizza)
steps: Cut onion into thin strips, cut bell pepper finely, and cut ham into 4 pieces.
Toast sandwich bread in a dry pan over medium-low heat for 1 minute per side to make the front and back slightly firm.
Spread 1/2 tbsp of ketchup on one side of the sandwich bread and place ham, onion, and bell pepper on top. Tear half a slice of cheese and place it on top.
Cover with a lid and cook over low heat for 3 minutes, or air fry at 180 degrees for 4 minutes to melt the cheese.
tips: Toasting the sandwich bread first keeps it from getting soggy.
The more cheese you add, the more it will stretch.

broccoli-chogochujang.desc: Blanched broccoli tossed in a sweet and sour gochujang sauce.
broccoli-chogochujang.name: Blanched Broccoli with Sweet Chili Sauce (Broccoli Chogochujang Muchim)
steps: Cut broccoli into bite-sized pieces, blanch in boiling water for 1 minute 30 seconds, rinse in cold water, and drain the water.
Mix gochujang 2 tbsp, vinegar 1 tbsp, sugar 1 tbsp, and minced garlic to make the chogochujang sauce.
Add the chogochujang sauce to broccoli, toss well, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Arrange neatly on a plate and serve.
tips: Blanching for too long will make the color dull.
Rinsing in cold water brings out the crunchiness.

broccoli-egg-salad.desc: A nutty salad tossed with yogurt instead of mayonnaise.
broccoli-egg-salad.name: Broccoli and Egg Salad (Broccoli Gyeran Salad)
steps: Put egg and cold water in a pot, and when it starts to boil, boil over medium heat for 10 minutes, cool in cold water, and peel.
Put broccoli into 1L boiling water, blanch for 1 minute 30 seconds, rinse in cold water, and drain. Cut into bite-sized pieces.
Coarsely mash egg with a fork.
In a bowl, mix 2 tbsp yogurt, 1 tsp vinegar, 1/4 tsp salt, and black pepper, then toss in broccoli and egg.
tips: Drain the broccoli well so the salad doesn't get watery.
Use plain or Greek yogurt with no sugar.

brown-rice-bibimbap.desc: A light bibimbap topped with plenty of seasoned vegetables and just one tablespoon of gochujang.
brown-rice-bibimbap.name: Brown Rice Bibimbap with Seasoned Vegetables (Hyeonmi Namul Bibimbap)
steps: Boil 1 L of water in a pot, blanch spinach for 30 seconds and soybean sprout for 3 minutes separately, rinse in cold water, and squeeze out the moisture firmly. Cut the spinach into 4 cm lengths.

Cut into thin strips the carrot and Korean zucchini. Coat a pan with 1 tsp of cooking oil and stir-fry carrot for 1 minute and Korean zucchini for 1 minute separately, seasoning them with 1/3 tsp of salt divided between them.
Toss spinach and soybean sprout in 1/2 tbsp (about 7 ml) of sesame oil.
Cook 2 eggs in a pan for 1 minute and 30 seconds, leaving the yolks runny.
Place cooked brown rice in a bowl, arrange the 4 types of seasoned vegetables and fried egg around it, and top with 1 tbsp of gochujang and the remaining sesame oil to mix.
tips: Squeeze out the moisture firmly after blanching vegetables so the bibimbap does not get soggy.
If you want to reduce gochujang, you can substitute it with 1 tsp of soy sauce.

brown-rice-chicken-bowl.desc: A high-protein rice bowl topped with chicken breast and broccoli stir-fried in soy sauce.
brown-rice-chicken-bowl.name: Chicken Breast and Broccoli Brown Rice Bowl (Hyeonmi-dakgaseumsal-beurokorli-deopbap)
steps: Cut chicken breast into 1.5 cm pieces and sprinkle with black pepper. Cut broccoli into bite-sized pieces and blanch in boiling water for 1 minute.
Heat cooking oil 1 tsp in a pan heated over medium heat, sauté minced garlic for 30 seconds, add chicken breast, and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add soy sauce 1 tbsp, oligosaccharide syrup 1 tsp, and water 2 tbsp (30 ml), and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add broccoli, stir-fry for 1 more minute, and place over cooked brown rice. Make sure the inside of chicken breast is cooked white through.
tips: Chicken breast becomes tough if stir-fried too long over high heat. Lower the heat when simmering.
The water used to blanch broccoli can be used for soup.

brown-rice-egg-bowl.desc: A quick 5-minute meal featuring brown rice topped with a soft-fried egg.
brown-rice-egg-bowl.name: Brown Rice and Soy Sauce Egg Rice Bowl (Hyeonmi Gyeran Ganjang Deopbap)
steps: Slice thinly the green onion, heat cooked brown rice in the microwave for 1 minute, and place it in a bowl.
Coat a pan heated over medium heat with 1 tsp of cooking oil, crack 2 eggs into it, and cook for 1 minute and 30 seconds until the edges are set.
Leave the yolk soft, reduce the heat to low, cook for 1 more minute, and place it on top of the cooked brown rice.
Drizzle with 1 tsp of soy sauce and 1/2 tsp of sesame oil, top with green onion and sesame seeds, and mix well to eat.
tips: Cooked brown rice contains more fiber than white rice, keeping you full longer.
Reducing the amount of soy sauce can lower sodium intake.

brown-rice-gimbap.desc: A light gimbap made with spinach, carrot, and cooked brown rice instead of pickled radish.
brown-rice-gimbap.name: Vegetable Brown Rice Gimbap (Hyeonmi-yachae-gimbap)
steps: Mix cooked brown rice with sesame oil 1/2 tbsp (about 7 ml), salt 1/3 tsp, and sesame seeds 1 tsp, and let it cool slightly.

Blanch spinach in boiling water 1 L for 30 seconds, rinse in cold water, and squeeze tightly. Beat 2 egg, cook thinly in cooking oil 1 tsp, and cut into long strips. Cut carrot into thin strips and sauté in a dry pan for 1 minute, and cut cucumber into 4 long lengthwise pieces and remove the seeds.
Place roasted seaweed on a bamboo mat and spread cooked brown rice thinly, leaving the top 2 cm of roasted seaweed bare.
Place egg, carrot, spinach, and cucumber in the center of the cooked brown rice, roll tightly using the bamboo mat, and seal the edge with water 1 tsp.
Brush the remaining sesame oil 1/2 tbsp on the outside, coat the knife as well, and slice into 1.5 cm thicknesses.
tips: Cooked brown rice has less stickiness, so you must let it cool slightly and roll it tightly so it doesn't burst.
Spreading cooked brown rice thinly can reduce calories even further.

brown-rice-kimchi-fried.desc: Kimchi fried rice made with brown rice to increase fullness and reduce oil.
brown-rice-kimchi-fried.name: Brown Rice Kimchi Fried Rice (Hyeonmi Kimchi Bokkeumbap)
steps: Cut kimchi into 1 cm sizes and slice thinly the green onion. Reserve only 1 tbsp (15 ml) of kimchi juice.
Coat a pan heated over medium heat with 1 tsp of cooking oil, stir-fry green onion for 30 seconds to release the aroma, then add kimchi and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add cooked brown rice and 1 tbsp of kimchi juice, and stir-fry for 2 minutes while pressing down with a spatula to separate the rice grains.
Cook an egg in a separate pan for 1 minute and 30 seconds, place it on top of the fried rice, and sprinkle with sesame oil and sesame seeds.
tips: Since cooked brown rice clumps together, microwave it for 1 minute, loosen it up, and then stir-fry.
If the kimchi is salty, omitting the juice while stir-frying reduces sodium.

brown-rice-tuna-bowl.desc: A tangy brown rice bowl topped with canned tuna and fresh vegetables.
brown-rice-tuna-bowl.name: Tuna and Vegetable Brown Rice Bowl (Hyeonmi-chamchi-chaesodapbap)
steps: Place canned tuna on a fine-mesh strainer to drain off as much canned tuna oil as possible. Tear iceberg lettuce by hand, cut tomato into bite-sized pieces, and slice cucumber thinly.
In a bowl, mix soy sauce 1 tsp, vinegar 1 tsp, oligosaccharide syrup 1/2 tsp, and sesame oil 1 tsp to make a sauce.
Place iceberg lettuce, tomato, cucumber, and canned tuna on top of cooked brown rice.
Drizzle the sauce over and mix well before eating.
tips: Draining canned tuna oil significantly reduces the calorie count.
You can substitute shredded green leaf lettuce or shredded cabbage for iceberg lettuce.

brown-rice-veg-porridge.desc: A stomach-friendly cooked brown rice porridge loaded with finely minced vegetables.
brown-rice-veg-porridge.name: Vegetable Brown Rice Porridge (Hyeonmi-yachaejuk)
steps: Finely mince carrot and Korean zucchini into 0.5 cm pieces.
Heat sesame oil 1 tsp in a pot and sauté carrot and Korean zucchini over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add cooked brown rice and water 500 ml, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover with a lid, and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir occasionally so the bottom doesn't burn.
When the rice grains have softened, pour in beaten egg, let sit for 30 seconds, stir once, and season with salt 1/3 tsp.
tips: Since brown rice grains are hard, they need to be simmered longer than white rice.
If the water reduces too much while simmering, add water 50 ml at a time to adjust the consistency.

buchu-gyeran-bokkeumbap.desc: A Chinese-style fried rice featuring aromatic garlic chives.
buchu-gyeran-bokkeumbap.name: Garlic Chive and Egg Fried Rice (Buchu Gyeran Bokkeumbap)
steps: Slice thinly the garlic chive into 1cm pieces.
Heat 1 tbsp cooking oil in a pan over high heat, scramble the egg, and set it aside.
In the same pan, stir-fry the cooked rice and 1 tbsp oyster sauce for 2 minutes.
Add the egg and garlic chive, stir-fry for 30 seconds more, and sprinkle with black pepper.
tips: Add the garlic chive at the very end to keep its aroma fresh.
Using cold leftover rice makes the fried rice fluffy.

buchu-jeon.desc: A savory garlic chive pancake loaded with aromatic garlic chive.
buchu-jeon.name: Garlic Chive Pancake (Buchu-jeon)
steps: Wash the garlic chive, drain, and cut into 4cm lengths, cut the onion into thin strips, and slice thinly the Cheongyang chili.
In a bowl, mix 100g Korean pancake mix, 150ml water, 1 egg, and 1/3 tsp salt to make the batter.
Add the garlic chive, the onion, and the Cheongyang chili, and mix gently.

Heat 3 tbsp cooking oil in a pan over medium heat, spread the batter thin, and fry for 3 minutes, flip, and fry for 3 more minutes. Finally, press down for 30 seconds on medium-high heat to make it crispy.
Mix 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1/2 tbsp vinegar, and Korean red pepper flakes to make a dipping sauce to serve alongside.
tips: Garlic chive releases water if left in the batter too long, so mix them right before frying.
You must spread the batter thin for it to be crispy.

buchu-muchim.desc: A tangy garlic chive salad that pairs wonderfully with meat dishes.
buchu-muchim.name: Garlic Chive Salad (Buchu-muchim)
steps: Wash the garlic chive in running water, drain well in a colander, cut into 5cm lengths, and cut the onion into thin strips.
In a bowl, mix Korean red pepper flakes 1tbsp, soy sauce 1tbsp, vinegar 1/2tbsp, sugar 1/2tbsp, and minced garlic to make the sauce.
Just before eating, add the garlic chive and onion to the sauce and toss gently with your fingertips. Kneading them roughly will create a grassy smell.
Add the sesame oil and sesame seeds, then mix lightly one more time.
tips: If you toss it with the sauce in advance, it will wilt, so toss it just before eating.
Eating it with pork belly or spicy stir-fried pork takes away the greasiness.

budae-jjigae.desc: A hearty stew packed with Spam, sausage, kimchi, and ramen.
budae-jjigae.name: Budae Jjigae (Army Stew)
steps: Cut the Spam and sausage into 1cm thickness, cut the kimchi into 3cm, cut the onion into thin strips, slice the green onion diagonally, and cut the tofu into 2cm.
In a bowl, mix 1 tbsp of gochujang, 1 tbsp of Korean red pepper flakes, 1 tbsp of soy sauce, 1 tbsp of minced garlic, 1/2 tbsp of sugar, and black pepper to make a seasoning paste.
Arrange the kimchi, onion, Spam, sausage, and tofu in a wide pot and place the seasoning paste in the center.
Pour 600ml of water around the edge and boil over high heat. When it comes to a boil, simmer over medium heat for 8 min.
Add the ramen and top with the green onion, boil for 3 more min, and eat once the noodles are cooked.
tips: Since the Spam and sausage are salty, add the soy sauce after tasting.
Placing 1 slice of cheese on top makes it creamy.

bugeo-guk.desc: Refreshing dried pollack and egg soup that is also great for hangovers.
bugeo-guk.name: Dried Pollack Soup (Bugeo Guk)
steps: Soak the dried pollack in cold water for 5 minutes, squeeze out the moisture, and cut into 3 cm lengths with kitchen shears. Slice the Korean radish thinly into flat pieces and diagonally slice the green onion.
Drizzle 1 tsp of sesame oil in a pot, and sauté the dried pollack over medium heat for 1 minute, then add the Korean radish and sauté for 1 more minute.
Pour in 700 ml of water, and once it starts boiling, cook over medium heat for 12 minutes.
Season with minced garlic, 1 tbsp of soup soy sauce, and 1/4 tsp of salt, pour in the beaten egg, wait 30 seconds, and add the green onion and black pepper.
tips: Sautéing the dried pollack in sesame oil makes the broth milky and rich.
Do not stir the egg right after adding it; wait 30 seconds.

bulgogi.desc: Beef marinated in a sweet and savory sauce.
bulgogi.name: Korean Beef Bulgogi
steps: Pat the beef dry with paper towels, and marinate for 20 minutes in a mixture of soy sauce 3 tbsp, sugar 1 and 1/2 tbsp, minced garlic 1 tbsp, sesame oil 1 tbsp, mirin 1 tbsp, water 3 tbsp, and black pepper.
Cut the onion into 0.5cm thin strips, slice the green onion diagonally, and cut the carrot into thin strips.
Heat cooking oil 1 tbsp in a pan over high heat and stir-fry the onion and carrot for 1 minute.
Add the marinated beef with its sauce, stir-fry over high heat for 3 minutes, then add the green onion and stir-fry for 2 more minutes. Reduce until some broth remains.
Finish by sprinkling sesame seeds.
tips: Adding 3 tbsp (45 ml) of pear juice or apple juice to the marinade makes the meat tender.
Adding soaked glass noodles 50g turns this into a bulgogi hot pot style.

bulgogi-bowl.desc: A delicious rice bowl topped with sweet marinated bulgogi.
bulgogi-bowl.name: Beef Bulgogi Rice Bowl (Bulgogi Deopbap)
steps: Mix soy sauce 3 tbsp, sugar 1 tbsp, minced garlic 1 tbsp, sesame oil 1 tbsp, mirin 1 tbsp, water 3 tbsp, and black pepper to make the sauce, then add the beef and marinate for 15 minutes.
Cut the onion and carrot into thin strips 0.5cm thick, and slice the green onion diagonally.
Heat cooking oil 1/2 tbsp in a pan over medium-high heat, and stir-fry the onion and carrot for 2 minutes.
Add the marinated beef along with the sauce and stir-fry for 3~4 minutes. Once the beef turns brown and a little broth remains, add the green onion and stir-fry for 1 more minute.
Put cooked rice in a bowl and top with the bulgogi and broth. Serve with the egg.
tips: Dab the beef with a paper towel to remove excess blood before marinating to reduce gaminess.
Pouring plenty of broth makes it tastier as it soaks into the rice.

busan-pig-gukbap.desc: Milky pork bone broth with sliced boiled pork over rice, a classic Busan comfort food.
busan-pig-gukbap.name: Busan Pork Soup Rice (Busan Dwaeji Gukbap)
steps: Soak the pork in cold water for 30 minutes to draw out blood, then blanch in boiling water for 5 minutes and rinse.
In a pot, combine 1.5 L of water, pork, 1/2 of a green onion, and minced garlic, boil over medium-low heat for 50 minutes, take it out, and slice thinly.
Season the broth with 1 tbsp of soup soy sauce and 1 tsp of salt, and boil a bit longer until it turns milky.
Put cooked rice and pork in a bowl, pour the hot broth over, and top with garlic chive, green onion, and black pepper.
tips: Seasoning with salted fermented shrimp makes it Busan-style.
Scalding the rice by pouring and draining the hot broth over it warms up the rice.

cabbage-bokkeum.desc: Crisp and sweetly tender stir-fried cabbage.
cabbage-bokkeum.name: Stir-Fried Cabbage (Cabbage-bokkeum)
steps: Cut the cabbage coarsely into 3cm widths, and cut the onion and carrot into thin strips.
In a pan heated over high heat, add cooking oil 1tbsp and minced garlic, and stir-fry for 20 seconds to release the aroma.
Add the carrot and onion and stir-fry for 1 minute, then add the cabbage and stir-fry over high heat for 2 minutes. You can stop when the edges of the cabbage become translucent.
Season with salt 1/3tsp, oyster sauce, and black pepper, stir-fry for 30 seconds, and finish.
tips: Stir-frying for too long releases moisture and makes it soggy. Stir-fry briefly over high heat.
Beating in eggs makes it stir-fried cabbage and egg.

cabbage-egg-bokkeum.desc: A light meal of stir-fried cabbage and eggs.
cabbage-egg-bokkeum.name: Stir-Fried Cabbage and Egg (Yangbaechu Gyeran Bokkeum)
steps: Cut the cabbage into 3cm wide strips and cut the onion into thin strips. Beat 3 eggs and mix in a pinch of salt.
Heat cooking oil 1 tbsp in a pan over high heat, pour in the eggs, stir roughly to make soft scrambled eggs, and set aside.
Add another 1 tbsp of cooking oil, stir-fry the onion for 30 seconds and the cabbage for 2 minutes over high heat. Cook just until the cabbage softens while keeping its crunch.
Season with salt 1/3 tsp, oyster sauce, and black pepper, then add the eggs back in and toss gently for 30 seconds.
tips: Stir-fry the cabbage briefly over high heat to keep it crisp.
Serve it over rice to make a rice bowl dish.

cabbage-roll-dubu.desc: A light and clean cabbage roll stuffed with tofu and pork.
cabbage-roll-dubu.name: Tofu Cabbage Rolls (Dubu Yangbaechu Roll)
steps: Blanch the cabbage leaf in boiling water for 2 minutes, take it out, and slice the thick stem thinly.
Mix the mashed tofu, minced pork, minced onion, and 1/4 tsp salt to make the filling.
Place the filling on the cabbage leaf, roll it up tightly, and place it in a pot with the seam facing down.
Pour 300ml water and 1 tbsp soy sauce, and simmer over medium heat for 15 minutes.
tips: Putting too much filling will cause them to burst, so one spoonful is just right.
Simmering in tomato sauce gives it a Western feel.

cabbage-salad-simple.desc: A crisp cabbage salad with a sweet and sour dressing.
cabbage-salad-simple.name: Cabbage Salad (Yangbaechu Salad)
steps: Cut the cabbage and carrot into thin strips, soak them in cold water for 5 minutes, and squeeze out the water firmly.
Mix olive oil 1 tbsp, vinegar 1 tbsp, oligosaccharide syrup 1 tbsp, and salt 1/4 tsp to make the dressing.
Toss the dressing with the vegetable and sprinkle sesame seeds.
Serve on a plate right away.
tips: Squeezing out the water prevents the dressing from becoming watery.
It also goes great as a side for pork cutlet.

cabbage-tofu-ssam.desc: A filling meal of steamed cabbage topped with tofu and ssamjang.
cabbage-tofu-ssam.name: Cabbage Tofu Ssam
steps: Remove the cabbage leaves one by one, wash them, and shave down the thick stems to make them thin. Cut the tofu into 1.5 cm thickness.
Boil 300 ml of water in a steamer or pot, place the cabbage on top, cover with a lid, steam for 4 minutes, remove, and let cool.
Place the tofu in the same steamer and steam for 3 minutes.
Mix 1 tbsp of doenjang, 1 tsp of gochujang, 1/2 tsp of oligosaccharide syrup, minced garlic, and sesame oil to make the ssamjang, then place the tofu and ssamjang on the cabbage and wrap it up.
tips: Cabbage gets mushy if steamed too long, so do not exceed 4 minutes.
It is also fine to dip it in 1 tsp of soy sauce instead of ssamjang.

cabbage-tomato-soup.desc: A warm and comforting vegetable soup, about 80 kcal per serving.
cabbage-tomato-soup.name: Cabbage Tomato Soup (Yangbaechu Tomato Supeu)
steps: Cut cabbage, onion, and carrot into 1.5cm sizes, and cut tomato into 8 wedges.
Drizzle cooking oil 1 tsp in a pot and sauté onion and carrot over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Add cabbage and tomato, sauté for 2 minutes, then pour water 600ml.
When it comes to a boil, reduce to low heat, simmer for 15 minutes, and season with salt 1/2 tsp and black pepper.
tips: Boiling the tomato for a long time reduces the sourness and brings out the sweetness.
If you make a big batch and portion it out, you can eat it for 3 days.

caesar-salad.desc: A Caesar salad topped with crispy bread and bacon.
caesar-salad.name: Caesar Salad
steps: Cut sandwich bread into 1 cm cubes and toast them in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden to make croutons. Cook bacon for 2 minutes until crisp and crumble finely.
Mix 2 tbsp of mayonnaise, 1 tbsp of vinegar, minced garlic, 1 tsp of oligosaccharide syrup, and black pepper to make the dressing.
Tear iceberg lettuce into bite-sized pieces, shake off excess water, and toss in the dressing.
Plate it and top with bacon, croutons, and torn cheese.
tips: Toss the dressing right before eating so the greens don't wilt.
Adding chicken breast makes it a full meal.

carbonara.desc: Creamy carbonara made with eggs and cheese.
carbonara.name: Carbonara
steps: In a large bowl, combine 2 eggs, 100ml milk, 2 slices of cheese (torn into small pieces), and black pepper, then whisk with a whisk or fork to make a sauce.
Boil 1 cup water, add 2 tsp salt, cook spaghetti for 6 to 7 minutes, drain in a colander, and reserve 1/2 cup (100ml) of the water.
Cut bacon into 1cm widths and crisp up in an ungreased pan over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds, then turn off the heat and add spaghetti and 3 tbsp (45ml) of water to mix.

Let it cool for 30 seconds, pour in the egg sauce, turn the heat to low, and stir continuously for 30 to 40 seconds until thickened. Be careful not to heat it too long or it will become scrambled eggs.
Sprinkle generously with black pepper and serve immediately. If the eggs seem undercooked, stir for 20 more seconds over low heat.
tips: If you add eggs while the pan is hot, they will clump. Turn off the heat and let the steam escape for a moment.
Adding water allows you to adjust the thickness of the sauce.

cat-chicken-broth.desc: A warm, hydrating soup boiled without any seasoning.
cat-chicken-broth.name: Cat Chicken Breast Soup
steps: Place the chicken breast in 300 ml of boiling water and cook completely over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Remove the chicken breast and shred or mince finely.
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve and let it cool completely.
Mix 1/3 of the shredded chicken breast into the broth for a single serving and refrigerate the rest.
tips: Never add onion, green onion, garlic, or salt.
Feed within 2 days when refrigerated.

cat-chicken-cube.desc: Snack cubes boiled without salt and frozen.
cat-chicken-cube.name: Cat Chicken Breast Cube (Goyangi Dakgaseumsal Kyubeu)
steps: Boil the chicken breast in 300 ml of boiling water for 10 minutes until cooked through.
Cool it down and blend it smoothly in a blender with 50 ml of the water it was boiled in.
Divide and pour into 6 compartments of an ice cube tray.
Freeze in the freezer for 3 hours and thaw 1 compartment at a time to feed.
tips: Never add salt, onion, or garlic.
Feed within 2 weeks of freezing.

cat-chicken-egg-pudding.desc: A soft pudding snack steamed without salt.
cat-chicken-egg-pudding.name: Cat Chicken Breast Egg Pudding
steps: Boil the chicken breast in boiling water for 10 minutes until fully cooked, then finely mince or blend in a food processor.
Mix 1 egg with 50 ml of water, beat well, and mix in the minced chicken breast.
Divide evenly into 4 small heat-safe bowls, boil 300 ml of water in a pot, cover, and steam over low heat for 12 minutes using a double boiler method.
Check that it is cooked through, let it cool completely, and feed 1 at a time.
tips: Nutritional balance is important for cats, so feed treats like this only occasionally.
Never feed raw eggs.

cat-salmon-treat.desc: A mild, savory salmon snack boiled without bones or skin.
cat-salmon-treat.name: Cat Boiled Salmon Treat
steps: Completely remove the bones and skin from the salmon.
Place the salmon in 300 ml of boiling water and boil for 6 minutes until fully cooked through.
Take it out, let it cool, check for any remaining bones, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Feed in 5 portions, one or two pieces at a time.
tips: Keep treats within 10% of your cat's daily calorie intake.
Can be stored in the freezer for up to 2 weeks.

cauliflower-fried-rice.desc: Low-carb fried rice made by grating cauliflower instead of rice.
cauliflower-fried-rice.name: Cauliflower Fried Rice
steps: Break the cauliflower into florets and mince them to the size of rice grains using a knife or grater, and finely mince the carrot and onion as well.
Coat a pan with cooking oil 1 tbsp and sauté the onion and carrot for 2 minutes.
Add the cauliflower and stir-fry over high heat for 3 minutes to remove moisture.
Push to one side to scramble the egg, and mix in soy sauce 1 tbsp and black pepper.
tips: Stir-fry over high heat so it doesn't get watery.
If you stir-fry too long it gets mushy, so take it off when it still has a slight crunch.

cauliflower-gui.desc: Cauliflower roasted golden in the oven or pan.
cauliflower-gui.name: Roasted Cauliflower (Cauliflower Gui)
steps: Divide the cauliflower into bite-sized florets.
Toss with olive oil 2 tbsp, salt 1/3 tsp, and black pepper.
Roast in an air fryer at 200 degrees for 12 minutes, or roll around in a pan over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Top with cheese and melt for 1 more minute.
tips: Spread them out without overlapping so they brown nicely.
Sprinkling Parmesan cheese powder is also delicious.

celery-apple-salad.desc: A crunchy salad tossed with celery and apple in yogurt.
celery-apple-salad.name: Celery Apple Salad
steps: Peel the tough fibers of celery with a peeler and slice thinly on an angle.
Cut apple into bite-sized pieces with the skin on and coarsely chop mixed nuts.
Mix yogurt 100 g, mayonnaise 1 tbsp, and salt 1/4 tsp to make the dressing.
Toss celery and apple with the dressing and sprinkle mixed nuts on top.
tips: Peeling the celery fibers makes it much more tender.
Toss just before eating to keep it crunchy.

chapssal-danhobak-juk.desc: A nutrient-rich porridge with a deep, sweet flavor.
chapssal-danhobak-juk.name: Sweet Pumpkin and Glutinous Rice Porridge (Chapssal-danhobak-juk)
steps: Wash the glutinous rice and soak it for 30 minutes. Scoop out the seeds from the kabocha squash, peel the skin, and cut it into 2 cm pieces.
Put the kabocha squash and 400 ml water in a pot, boil for 15 minutes until fully tender, and mash them.
Add the glutinous rice and the remaining 300 ml water, and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes while stirring.
Season with 1/3 tsp salt and 1 tsp sugar.
tips: Soaking the glutinous rice ensures it turns out smooth even with a short cooking time.
If the consistency is too thick, add 50 ml water at a time.

chapssal-juk.desc: A smooth, gentle white porridge made with easily digestible glutinous rice.
chapssal-juk.name: Glutinous Rice Porridge (Chapssal-juk)
steps: Wash the glutinous rice, soak it in cold water for 30 minutes, then drain in a sieve.
Drizzle 1 tsp sesame oil in a pot and stir-fry the glutinous rice over medium heat for 2 minutes until the grains become translucent.
Pour in 600 ml water, reduce the heat to low once it starts boiling, cover with a lid, and simmer for 25 minutes. Stir occasionally so the bottom doesn't burn.
Season with 1/3 tsp salt.
tips: Glutinous rice burns easily, so be sure to keep the heat on low.
Serve alongside kimchi or seasoned beef (jangjorim).

cheese-egg-roll.desc: A rolled omelet with a stretchy cheese pull.
cheese-egg-roll.name: Cheese Rolled Omelet (Cheese Egg-roll)
steps: Beat 4 egg, mix with 2 tbsp milk, 1 pinch salt, and green onion, then strain once through a sieve.
Wipe a thin layer of cooking oil over a pan preheated on low heat with a paper towel and pour in 1/3 of the egg mixture.
When the edges are set and the top is half-cooked, place 1 cheese on top, roll it up tightly from the edge, and push it to one side.
Grease the empty space, pour in half of the remaining egg mixture, let it flow under the rolled egg, and roll it up again.
Roll one more time with the remaining egg mixture and 1 cheese to shape it, let it sit for 1 minute, transfer to a cutting board, let cool for 2 minutes, and slice.
tips: You must keep the heat on low so the outside doesn't burn and the inside stays soft.
Using 30g mozzarella cheese makes it even stretchier.

cheese-ramen.desc: A single slice of cheese makes this ramen rich and creamy.
cheese-ramen.name: Cheese Ramen
steps: Pour 550ml of water into a pot and bring it to a boil over high heat. Slice thinly the green onion.
When the water boils, add the ramen and soup packet, and cook for 2 minutes and 30 seconds.
Crack in the egg, top with the green onion, and cook for 30 seconds more. It is best when the noodles are chewy.
Turn off the heat, place the cheese on top, cover with the lid, and let it sit for 30 seconds to melt.
tips: The cheese is salty, so using only 2/3 of the soup packet will reduce the saltiness.
Replacing a portion of the water with 100ml of milk makes a creamy ramen.

cheese-tteokbokki.name: Cheese Tteokbokki
steps: Dissolve gochujang 2 tbsp, Korean red pepper flakes 1 tbsp, sugar 1 tbsp, and soy sauce 1 tbsp in water 400ml and bring to a boil.
Add rice cake and fish cake, and simmer over medium heat for 8 minutes.
Add green onion, top with cheese, cover with a lid, and let melt for 1 minute.
Transfer to a bowl and serve while hot.
tips: If the rice cake is hardened, soak it in lukewarm water for 10 minutes.
Cheese should be added at the end so it is chewy.

cheonan-hodu-gwaja.desc: Walnut pastries baked with red bean paste and walnuts.
cheonan-hodu-gwaja.name: Cheonan Walnut Pastry (Cheonan Hodu-gwaja)
steps: Mix flour, egg, milk, and 1 tbsp of sugar to make a smooth batter.
