Mash the boiled red bean, mix with 1 tbsp of sugar, and add mixed nuts to make the red bean paste.
Grease a muffin tin or pan with butter, fill halfway with batter, top with the red bean paste, and cover with more batter.
Bake in an oven or air fryer at 180 degrees for 15 minutes.
tips: Mix lightly so air doesn't get into the batter and cause it to puff up too much.
They are even chewier when cooled.

cheongguk-jang-chungcheong.desc: A rich and savory fermented soybean paste stew with tofu and kimchi.
cheongguk-jang-chungcheong.name: Chungcheong-style Cheonggukjang Stew (Cheonggukjang Jjigae)
steps: Cut the kimchi, onion, Korean zucchini, and tofu into bite-sized pieces.
Put water 500ml, kimchi, onion, minced garlic, and Korean red pepper flakes in a pot and boil for 8 minutes.
Add the Korean zucchini and tofu and boil for 5 more minutes.
Dissolve cheonggukjang 3 tbsp, boil for just 3 minutes, and top with green onion.
tips: Boiling cheonggukjang for too long weakens its aroma and reduces nutrition.
Ventilate the room if you are worried about the smell.

cheonggukjang-jjigae.desc: A hearty and earthy cheonggukjang stew loaded with tofu and zucchini.
cheonggukjang-jjigae.name: Rich Soybean Paste Stew (Cheonggukjang Jjigae)
steps: Put water 500 ml and anchovy 10 g in a pot, bring to a boil, simmer over medium heat for 7 min, and remove the anchovies.
Cut Korean zucchini and onion into bite-sized pieces, tofu into 2 cm cubes, and slice green onion and Cheongyang chili diagonally.
Add Korean zucchini and onion to the broth, boil for 5 min, then dissolve cheonggukjang 60 g along with Korean red pepper flakes and minced garlic.
Add tofu, boil for 5 min, then add green onion and Cheongyang chili and cook for 2 more min.
tips: Boiling cheonggukjang for too long can destroy its aroma, so add it near the end.
Ventilate the kitchen while boiling if you are worried about the strong aroma.

cheonggyeongchae-bokkeum.desc: A Chinese-style vegetable stir-fry with a crisp texture.
cheonggyeongchae-bokkeum.name: Stir-Fried Bok Choy in Oyster Sauce (Cheonggyeongchae Bokkeum)
steps: Trim the root of the bok choy, separate into individual leaves, wash, and cut larger leaves in half.
Heat cooking oil 1 tbsp in a pan over high heat and stir-fry minced garlic for 20 seconds.
Add the bok choy, stir-fry for 1 minute, then add water 2 tbsp (30ml) and oyster sauce 1 tbsp, and stir-fry for 1 minute more.
Turn off the heat as soon as the leaves wilt slightly.
tips: Stir-fry briefly over high heat to keep it crunchy.
If any liquid forms, discard the liquid when plating.

cheongyang-gochu-doenjang-muchim.desc: A spicy side dish made by tossing Cheongyang chili peppers in doenjang.
cheongyang-gochu-doenjang-muchim.name: Seasoned Cheongyang Chili in Doenjang (Cheongyang Gochu Doenjang-muchim)
steps: Remove the stems of the Cheongyang chili, split them in half, wash, and drain the water.
Steam them in a steamer or microwave for 2 minutes to cook.
Mix 1 tbsp of doenjang, Korean red pepper flakes, 1 tsp of sugar, and 1 tbsp of sesame oil.
Toss the chili in the sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
tips: If it is too spicy, increase the sugar slightly.
Placing this on a spoonful of rice will instantly revive your appetite.

chicken-breast-salad.name: Chicken Breast Salad (Dalgaseomsal Salade)
steps: In a pot, bring 600ml of water and salt 1/3 tsp to a boil, then add the chicken breast and cook over high heat for 2 minutes, turn off the heat, cover with a lid, and let sit for 12 minutes.
Take out the chicken breast, let it cool for 5 minutes, and tear it along the grain with your hands. Make sure the inside is white and has no pink color left.
Cut the cabbage into thin strips, slice the cucumber into half-moons, cut the tomato into bite-sized pieces, and slice the onion thinly.
Mix soy sauce 1 tbsp, vinegar 1 tbsp, oligosaccharide syrup 1 tbsp, sesame oil, and black pepper to make the dressing.
Place the vegetables and chicken breast on a plate and top with the dressing and sesame seeds.
tips: Cooking with residual heat keeps the chicken breast moist instead of dry.
Do not throw away the broth from boiling; use it in soups or porridges.

chicken-breast-steak.name: Chicken Breast Steak
steps: Slice open the thick part of chicken breast with a knife to even out the thickness, then season with 1/2 tsp of salt and black pepper.
Mix 1 tbsp of mustard, 1 tbsp of oligosaccharide syrup, and minced garlic to make the sauce.
Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a pan and pan-sear chicken breast over medium heat for 5 minutes on each side.
Spoon the sauce over it, reduce for 1 minute, let it rest for 5 minutes, and slice.
tips: Do not slice immediately after cooking; let it rest so the juices stay inside.
Remove it when the inside is cooked through and opaque.

chicken-broccoli-bokkeum.desc: A stir-fry packed with protein using only one teaspoon of oil.
chicken-broccoli-bokkeum.name: Stir-Fried Chicken Breast and Broccoli (Dakkaseumsal Broccoli Bokkeum)
steps: Cut chicken breast into 1.5cm pieces and sprinkle with black pepper. Cut broccoli into bite-sized pieces, blanch in boiling water for 1 minute, and rinse in cold water.
Heat a pan over medium heat, drizzle 1 tsp cooking oil, and stir-fry minced garlic for 30 seconds to release the aroma.
Add chicken breast and stir-fry for 3 minutes until the outside turns white, then add 1 tbsp soy sauce and 3 tbsp (45ml) water and simmer for 1 minute.
Add broccoli and stir-fry for 1 more minute to finish. Check that the inside of the chicken breast is cooked white.
tips: Blanching the broccoli beforehand means you won't need to stir-fry it long in the pan, keeping its color vibrant.
Turn off the heat when the 3 tbsp water reduces so it doesn't get dry and tough.

chicken-cucumber-naengchae.desc: A refreshing cold salad tossed in a tangy soy sauce.
chicken-cucumber-naengchae.name: Chicken and Cucumber Cold Salad (Oi-Dakkaseumsal-Naengchae)
steps: Boil water 500ml and salt 1/3 tsp in a pot, add chicken breast, cook over high heat for 2 minutes, turn off the heat, cover, and leave for 12 minutes.
Take out chicken breast, let it cool, and shred by hand along the grain.
Cut cucumber in half and slice thinly on an angle.
Toss chicken breast and cucumber in a sauce mixed with vinegar 1 tbsp, soy sauce 1 tbsp, oligosaccharide syrup 1 tsp, sesame oil 1 tsp, and minced garlic, then sprinkle with sesame seeds.
tips: The cucumber stays crunchy only when tossed right before eating.
You can enjoy it even more refreshingly if you leave the chicken breast in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.

chicken-curry-rice.desc: A mild and light curry made with chicken breast.
chicken-curry-rice.name: Chicken Breast Curry
steps: Cut chicken breast, potato, onion, and carrot into 2 cm pieces.
Drizzle 1 tbsp cooking oil in a pan and stir-fry onion for 4 minutes and chicken breast for 3 minutes.
Add potato, carrot, and 500 ml water, bring to a boil, and simmer over low heat for 12 minutes.
Dissolve 4 tbsp curry powder, simmer for 5 minutes, and serve over cooked rice.
tips: Chicken breast gets tough if boiled too long, so you can add it at the end.
Adding a little milk makes it milder.

chicken-katsu.desc: Crispy chicken cutlet made with chicken breast.
chicken-katsu.name: Chicken Cutlet (Chicken Katsu)
steps: Slice the chicken breast in half horizontally to open it up, pound with the back of a knife, and season with salt 1/3 tsp and black pepper.
Coat in flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs in that order.
Fry in cooking oil at 170°C for 3 minutes on each side until golden, then drain the oil.
Slice into bite-sized pieces and serve with tonkatsu sauce 4 tbsp.
tips: Pounding it flat helps it cook evenly and keeps it tender.
You can also make it in an air fryer at 190°C for 12 minutes.

chicken-mayo-deopbap.desc: Rice topped with chicken breast and a creamy mayonnaise sauce.
chicken-mayo-deopbap.name: Chicken Mayo Rice Bowl (Chikin Mayo Deopbap)
steps: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and marinate in soy sauce 2 tbsp and sugar 1 tsp for 10 minutes.
Heat cooking oil 1 tbsp in a pan and sauté the chicken breast over medium heat for 6 minutes.
Fry the egg sunny-side up with a soft yolk.
Place cooked rice in a bowl, top with the chicken breast and egg, drizzle with mayonnaise 2 tbsp, and crumble roasted seaweed over top.
tips: Dusting a little starch on the chicken breast makes it tender.
Mixing a drop of soy sauce into the mayonnaise gives it a richer flavor.

chicken-nanban.desc: Fried chicken topped with a tangy sauce and mayonnaise tartar.
chicken-nanban.name: Chicken Nanban
steps: Boil 1 egg, chop finely, chop onion very finely, and mix with mayonnaise 3 tbsp to make the tartar sauce.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces, season with salt and black pepper, coat with starch and flour, and dip in beaten egg 1 egg.
Fry in cooking oil at 170°C for 5 minutes until crispy.
Boil soy sauce 2 tbsp, vinegar 2 tbsp, and sugar 2 tbsp to make a sauce, dip and coat the fried chicken in it, then top with the tartar sauce.
tips: If left sitting in the sauce it will get soggy, so take it out right away.
It makes a hearty and filling meal when served with cooked rice.

chicken-nugget.desc: Crispy nuggets cooked in an air fryer with less oil.
chicken-nugget.name: Chicken Air Fryer Nuggets
steps: Cut the chicken into 3 cm pieces and season with 1/3 tsp of salt and black pepper.
Coat in flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs in that order.
Place them in the air fryer basket without overlapping and spray cooking oil evenly.
Cook at 180°C for 8 minutes, flip, and cook for 4 more minutes until cooked through.
tips: Cut one piece open to check if the inside is cooked white.
They also go well with yogurt instead of ketchup or mustard.

chicken-teriyaki.desc: Pan-seared chicken thigh glazed with a sweet and savory soy sauce.
chicken-teriyaki.name: Chicken Teriyaki
steps: Score the skin side of the chicken and sprinkle with black pepper. Mix 3 tbsp of soy sauce, 2 tbsp of mirin, 1 tbsp of sugar, and minced garlic to make the sauce.
Heat 1 tbsp of cooking oil in a pan over medium heat, place the chicken skin-side down, and cook for 4 minutes.
Flip and cook for 3 more minutes, then wipe the oil from the pan with a paper towel.
Pour in the sauce, simmer over low heat while spooning it over the chicken for 3 minutes until glossy, then turn off the heat and cut into bite-sized pieces.
tips: The sauce burns easily, so simmer over low heat.
It is also great served over rice as a rice bowl.

chickpea-curry.desc: A vegetarian curry simmered with chickpeas and vegetables.
chickpea-curry.name: Chickpea Curry
steps: Cut the onion, potato, and carrot into 2 cm sizes.
Heat 1 tbsp cooking oil in a deep pan and sauté the onion over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Add the potato, carrot, chickpea, and 500 ml water, bring to a boil, and simmer over low heat for 12 minutes.
Dissolve 4 tbsp curry powder and simmer while stirring for 5 minutes.
Serve over cooked rice.
tips: Add the curry powder at the end so it doesn't stick to the bottom.
Adding tomatoes makes it tangy and delicious.

chickpea-salad.desc: A filling salad made with boiled chickpeas.
chickpea-salad.name: Chickpea Salad
steps: Drain the chickpea in a sieve.
Dice the cucumber and tomato, and finely mince the onion.
Mix 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp vinegar, 1/3 tsp salt, and black pepper to make the dressing.
Place all ingredients in a bowl, add the dressing, and toss.
tips: Rinse canned chickpea before using.
Soak the onion in cold water for 5 minutes to remove the pungent taste and make it mild.

chodang-sundubu-yangnyeom.desc: Gangneung-style soft tofu served with a savory seasoned soy sauce.
chodang-sundubu-yangnyeom.name: Soft Tofu with Seasoned Soy Sauce (Chodang-sundubu Yangnyeom)
steps: Warm the soft tofu in a pot and transfer it to a bowl.
Slice thinly green onion and mix with 2 tbsp of soy sauce, Korean red pepper flakes, minced garlic, 1 tbsp of sesame oil, and sesame seeds to make the seasoned soy sauce.
Drizzle the seasoned soy sauce over the soft tofu and serve.
Scoop and eat with a spoon while it is hot.
tips: Soft tofu tastes nuttier when warmed up.
Chodang tofu has a clean and mild flavor because seawater is used instead of bittern.

chungcheong-dakbaeksuk.desc: A tender chicken soup simmered long with glutinous rice and green onion.
chungcheong-dakbaeksuk.name: Korean Chicken Soup with Glutinous Rice (Chungcheong-style Dakbaeksuk)
steps: Rinse the chicken in cold water to remove any fat clumps, and soak the glutinous rice for 30 minutes.
Stuff the chicken cavity with half of the soaked glutinous rice and 2 chestnuts.
Place the chicken, remaining chestnuts, minced garlic, green onion, and 2 L of water in a pot, bring to a boil over high heat, and simmer over medium-low heat for 50 minutes.
Season with 1 tsp of salt and black pepper, shred the chicken meat, and serve with the broth.
tips: Skim off the foam while boiling to keep the broth clean.
Making porridge with the remaining broth turns it into chicken porridge.

chungcheong-hobak-doenjang.desc: A savory doenjang stew packed with plenty of Korean zucchini.
chungcheong-hobak-doenjang.name: Korean Zucchini Doenjang Stew (Chungcheong-style Hobak-doenjangjjigae)
steps: Boil the anchovy in 600 ml of water for 5 minutes and remove them, then cut the Korean zucchini, onion, and tofu into bite-sized pieces.
Dissolve 2 tbsp of doenjang in the broth and bring to a boil.
Add the onion and minced garlic and cook for 5 minutes, then add the Korean zucchini and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu, green onion, and Cheongyang chili and cook for 3 minutes.
tips: Cutting the Korean zucchini thickly gives it a great texture.
Using rice-rinsing water makes the soup even more savory.

chungmu-gimbap.desc: Simple rice-only seaweed rolls served with spicy seasoned squid and radish kimchi, a Tongyeong specialty.
chungmu-gimbap.name: Chungmu Gimbap
steps: Cut Korean radish into cubes, marinate in 1 tsp of salt for 15 minutes, drain moisture, and toss with 1 tbsp of Korean red pepper flakes, 1/2 tbsp of sugar, and 1 tbsp of vinegar to make radish kimchi.
Blanch squid in boiling water for 2 minutes, cut into bite-sized pieces, and toss with 2 tbsp of Korean red pepper flakes, 1/2 tbsp of sugar, minced garlic, and sesame oil.
Cut roasted seaweed into quarters, put a little cooked rice on each, and roll thinly and tightly.
Serve the gimbap alongside squid and radish kimchi.
tips: Because there are no fillings inside, the gimbap spoils less easily at room temperature.
Leaving it for 30 minutes to let the seasonings absorb makes it tastier.

cold-udon-tsuyu.desc: Cold udon noodles tossed in a refreshing tsuyu broth.
cold-udon-tsuyu.name: Cold Udon (Naeng Udon)
steps: Blanch the udon noodle in boiling water for 1 minute, rinse in cold water, and drain.
Mix 3 tbsp of tsuyu in 200ml of water and add ice.
Grate the Korean radish, squeeze out the moisture, and slice thinly the green onion.
Place the udon noodle in a bowl, pour in the broth, and top with Korean radish, green onion, and crushed roasted seaweed.
tips: The concentration of tsuyu varies by product, so adjust while tasting.
It tastes even better when chilled in the refrigerator.

corn-cheese.desc: Sweet and savory baked corn with melted cheese.
corn-cheese.name: Korean Corn Cheese
steps: Drain the canned corn thoroughly in a strainer.
In an oven-safe dish or small pan, combine corn, mayonnaise 2 tbsp, sugar 1 tsp, and butter 1 tsp, and mix well.
Tear cheese 2 slices and place them on top.
Cook in the air fryer at 190 degrees for 5 minutes, or in the microwave for 2 minutes, and take it out when the cheese is melted and golden.
tips: Draining the corn well prevents it from getting soggy.
Sprinkling parsley flakes or pepper adds great flavor.

corn-jeon.desc: A crispy pan-fried dish featuring sweet kernels of corn.
corn-jeon.name: Crispy Corn Pancake (Corn-jeon)
steps: Drain the corn thoroughly in a strainer.
In a bowl, combine corn, Korean pancake mix 3 tbsp, egg 1, water 3 tbsp (45 ml), and salt 1/4 tsp, and mix them together.
Heat cooking oil 2 tbsp in a pan over medium heat, drop spoonfuls of the batter into round shapes.
Pan-fry until golden brown for 2 minutes and 30 seconds on each side.
tips: If the batter is too wet, it will fall apart, so measure the water accurately.
Making them small and bite-sized is great for kids' snacks.

corn-soup.desc: A sweet soup made by blending corn.
corn-soup.name: Corn Soup
steps: Mince onion and stir-fry in 1 tbsp butter over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Add corn and 100 ml water and boil for 5 minutes.
Add 300 ml milk, blend until smooth in a blender, transfer back to the pot, and warm over low heat for 5 minutes.
Season with 1/3 tsp salt.
tips: Straining it through a fine mesh sieve makes it even smoother.
Boiling over high heat will curdle the milk, so keep it on low heat.

cream-cheese-egg-mal.desc: A soft rolled omelet with a cream cheese filling.
cream-cheese-egg-mal.name: Cream Cheese Rolled Omelet (Cream Cheese Gyeran-mari)
steps: Whisk 4 eggs with 1/4 tsp of salt and strain through a sieve.
Coat a pan over low heat with cooking oil, pour in 1/3 of the egg mixture, and when it is half cooked, place the cream cheese in a line down the center.
Roll it up, pour the remaining egg mixture in two separate batches, and continue rolling.
Let it cool and slice thickly.
tips: Cook over low heat so the outside doesn't burn and the cheese melts.
If the cream cheese is cold, leave it at room temperature for a moment before using.

cream-cheese-pasta.desc: An easy, creamy pasta made with cream cheese.
cream-cheese-pasta.name: Cream Cheese Pasta
steps: Boil 1.5 L of boiling water with 1 tsp of salt, cook the spaghetti for 8 minutes, and drain.
Cut the bacon into 1 cm pieces, fry until crispy in a pan, and add the minced garlic.
Add 150 ml of milk and cream cheese, and stir over low heat for 3 minutes to melt.
Add the spaghetti, toss for 1 minute, and sprinkle with black pepper.
tips: It will separate over high heat, so be sure to use low heat.
Adding 2 tbsp of pasta water makes adjusting the consistency easy.

cream-cheese-salmon-sandwich.desc: A sandwich made with salmon and cream cheese instead of smoked salmon.
cream-cheese-salmon-sandwich.name: Salmon and Cream Cheese Sandwich
steps: Lightly toast the sandwich bread in a pan for 1 minute on each side.
Spread plenty of cream cheese on 2 slices of sandwich bread.
Top with the iceberg lettuce, thinly sliced cucumber, and salmon, and sprinkle with black pepper.
Cover with the remaining sandwich bread and cut in half.
tips: Use fresh salmon and eat it on the same day.
Serving it with capers or onion adds great flavor.

cream-pasta-fresh.desc: Rich cream pasta made even creamier with heavy cream.
cream-pasta-fresh.name: Heavy Cream Pasta
steps: Boil 1 L of water, add 2 tsp of salt, cook the spaghetti for 6-7 minutes, and drain in a strainer. Reserve 1/2 cup (100 ml) of the pasta water.
Cut the onion into thin strips and slice the bacon into 1 cm widths.
Sauté the bacon in a pan over medium heat for 2 minutes to render the fat, then add the onion and minced garlic and sauté for 2 more minutes.
Pour in 200 ml of heavy cream and 100 ml of milk, simmer over low heat for 3 minutes, then tear and melt the cheese into it.
Add the spaghetti and toss for 1-2 minutes; adjust the consistency with the reserved pasta water if it gets too thick, and sprinkle with black pepper.
tips: Heavy cream will separate if boiled over high heat. Keep it on low heat.
It is high in calories, so stick to a single serving size.

cream-spaghetti.desc: Rich and creamy spaghetti made with milk and cheese.
cream-spaghetti.name: Cream Spaghetti
steps: Boil 1 cup water, add 2 tsp salt, cook spaghetti for 6 to 7 minutes, and drain in a colander. Reserve only 1/2 cup (100ml) of the water.
Cut onion into 0.5cm-thick strips and cut bacon into 1cm widths.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a pan heated over medium-low heat, stir-fry minced garlic and onion for 2 minutes, and bacon for 1 minute.
Sprinkle 1 tbsp flour and stir-fry for 30 seconds to get rid of the flour smell.
Pour 300ml milk in three batches, stirring to dissolve each time. Simmering over low heat for 3 minutes will make it thick. Be careful not to use high heat or it will overflow.

Tear 2 slices of cheese and add them to melt, then add spaghetti and toss for 1 to 2 minutes. If the consistency is too thick, adjust with 2 to 3 tbsp (30 to 45ml) of water and sprinkle with black pepper.
tips: Milk boils over easily, so be sure to keep the heat low.
Adding flour creates a thick sauce even without heavy cream.

croque-monsieur.desc: A French-style grilled sandwich with ham and cheese.
croque-monsieur.name: Croque Monsieur
steps: Spread a thin layer of mustard on 2 slices of sandwich bread, top with 2 slices of ham and 2 slices of cheese each, and cover with the remaining sandwich bread.
Melt butter in a pan and toast the sandwich over medium-low heat for 2 minutes on each side.
Spread milk on top, add 1 more slice of cheese to each, cover with a lid, and melt for 2 minutes.
Cut in half and serve.
tips: Cook over low heat so the cheese melts and the bread does not burn.
Top with a fried egg to make it a Croque Madame.

cucumber-salad.desc: A crunchy and tangy summer side dish.
cucumber-salad.name: Spicy Cucumber Salad (Oi-Muchim)
steps: Rub the cucumber with coarse salt to wash, cut into 0.5cm thick half-moons, sprinkle with 1/2 tsp of salt, and pickle for 10 minutes. Cut the onion into thin strips.
Squeeze the pickled cucumbers firmly by hand to drain the water and place them in a bowl.
Add 1 tbsp of Korean red pepper flakes, 1 tbsp of vinegar, 1 tsp of sugar, minced garlic, and onion, then toss together.
Add 1 tsp of sesame oil and sesame seeds, then mix lightly.
tips: It is crunchiest when eaten right after mixing.
If the cucumber tastes bitter, cut off 2cm from both ends.

daegu-napjak-mandu.desc: Daegu-style flat dumplings filled with glass noodles and garlic chives wrapped in thin dough and pan-fried.
daegu-napjak-mandu.name: Daegu Napjak Mandu (Flat Dumplings)
steps: Mix 1 cup flour, 1/3 tsp salt, and 100ml water to make a dough, and let it rest for 20 minutes.
Boil glass noodles, cut them short, finely chop garlic chives and onion, and mix with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp sesame oil to make the filling.
Roll out the dough very thinly, place the filling on top, fold it flat, and press the edges to seal.
Drizzle 3 tbsp cooking oil in a pan and pan-fry over medium heat for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
tips: The dumpling wrappers must be rolled out as thin as possible to achieve the crispy texture characteristic of flat dumplings.
They also taste great dipped in a seasoned spicy sauce (tteokbokki sauce).

daegu-spicy-galbi-jjim.desc: Daegu Dongin-dong style braised short ribs cooked down with Cheongyang chili peppers and red pepper flakes for a spicy kick.
daegu-spicy-galbi-jjim.name: Daegu-style Spicy Galbi Jjim
steps: Soak beef in cold water for 30 minutes to draw out blood, then blanch in boiling water for 5 minutes and rinse.
Place beef, 5 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp minced garlic, and 600ml water in a pot, and simmer over medium heat for 30 minutes.
Cut potato, carrot, and onion into chunky pieces, add them in, and braise for 20 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp Korean red pepper flakes and Cheongyang chili, simmer for another 5 minutes, and turn off the heat once the broth is reduced and slightly thickened.
tips: Adding a generous amount of garlic is a signature of the Daegu style.
Braise over low heat for a long time until the beef becomes tender.

daegu-ttaro-gukbap.desc: Daegu-style soup with ox blood and beef served separately from cooked rice.
daegu-ttaro-gukbap.name: Daegu-style Separate Rice and Soup (Daegu Ttaro-gukbap)
steps: Soak the beef in cold water for 15 minutes to draw out the blood, boil it with Korean radish in 1.2 L of water for 40 minutes, and shred the beef along the grain.
Cut the ox blood into bite-sized pieces and blanch in boiling water for 3 minutes.
Add 3 tbsp of Korean red pepper flakes, 1 tbsp of minced garlic, 2 tbsp of soup soy sauce, and soybean sprout to the broth and boil for 10 minutes.
Add the shredded beef, ox blood, and green onion, boil for 3 minutes, and serve separately from cooked rice.
tips: Use fresh ox blood and do not boil it for too long.
Mix the separately served cooked rice into the soup to eat it as ttaro-gukbap.

daejeon-dubu-duruchigi.desc: A spicy Daejeon-style braised dish made with tofu and pork.
daejeon-dubu-duruchigi.name: Spicy Tofu and Pork Stir-fry (Daejeon-style Dubu-duruchigi)
steps: Cut the tofu into thick slices, pork into bite-sized pieces, onion into thin strips, and slice the green onion thinly.
Mix Korean red pepper flakes, gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, and minced garlic to make the sauce.
Place the pork and half of the sauce in a pan and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the onion, 150 ml of water, tofu, and the remaining sauce, braise over medium heat for 10 minutes, and top with the green onion.
tips: Pan-frying the tofu beforehand prevents it from breaking apart.
You can also add kalguksu (knife-cut noodle) noodles to eat with it.

daepa-jeon.desc: Savory pancake made with whole green onions.
daepa-jeon.name: Green Onion Pancake (Daepa-jeon)
steps: Cut the green onion to the length of the pan and split the white part in half.
Make a batter with Korean pancake mix, 100 ml water, and 1/4 tsp salt.
Heat cooking oil in a pan, lay the green onion neatly, and pour a thin layer of batter over it.
Beat 1 egg, pour it over the top, and pan-fry over medium heat for 4 minutes on each side until crispy.
tips: Using less batter makes it crispier.
Flip it over all at once when turning.

dak-breast-soy-bokkeum.desc: Low-fat chicken breast stir-fried until moist and tender.
dak-breast-soy-bokkeum.name: Stir-Fried Chicken Breast in Soy Sauce (Dalgaseomsal Ganjang Bokkeum)
steps: Slice the chicken breast diagonally into 0.7cm thick pieces by laying the knife flat, and marinate in mirin 1 tbsp, minced garlic, and black pepper for 10 minutes. Cut the onion into thin strips, bell pepper into 1cm wide strips, and slice the green onion diagonally.
Heat cooking oil 1 tbsp in a pan over medium heat, pan-fry the chicken breast for 2 minutes on each side to brown the surface.
Add the onion and stir-fry for 2 minutes, then add soy sauce 2 tbsp, oligosaccharide syrup 1 tbsp, and water 3 tbsp and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the bell pepper and green onion and stir-fry for 1 minute to finish. Cut a piece of the chicken breast to check that the inside is cooked white.
tips: Cooking too long will make it dry, so stir-fry briefly over high heat.
Coating the meat in 1/2 tbsp (about 4g) of starch powder before frying makes it even softer.

dak-jorim.desc: A everyday side dish of chicken and potatoes braised in a soy sauce glaze.
dak-jorim.name: Braised Chicken (Dak Jorim)
steps: Blanch the chicken in boiling water for 2 minutes and rinse, cut the potato into 4 cm pieces, cut the onion into large chunks, and slice the green onion and Cheongyang chili diagonally.
In a pot, combine 4 tbsp soy sauce, 1 and 1/2 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp minced garlic, black pepper, and 300 ml water, then add the chicken and bring to a boil over high heat.
When it comes to a boil, reduce the heat to medium, cook for 10 minutes, and then add the potato and onion.
Cover with a lid and braise over medium-low heat for 15 minutes, basting with the broth in between. It is done when a chopstick easily pierces the potato.
Remove the lid and braise for 5 minutes until 1/3 of the broth remains, then add the green onion, Cheongyang chili, and oligosaccharide syrup and boil for 1 more minute.
tips: Turn up the heat at the very end of braising to give it a nice gloss.
You can also make braised quail eggs if you add 2 boiled eggs to braise together.

dak-kalguksu.desc: Light knife-cut noodle soup boiled in chicken broth.
dak-kalguksu.name: Chicken Knife-Cut Noodle Soup (Dak-kalguksu)
steps: Put water 1L, chicken breast, and onion in a pot, boil for 15 minutes, take out the chicken, and shred it.
Add soup soy sauce 1 tbsp and minced garlic to the broth and boil.
Shake off the flour from the knife-cut wheat noodles and add them to boil for 6 minutes. Cut the Korean zucchini into thin strips and add them together.
Top with the shredded chicken and green onion, and season with salt 1/2 tsp.
tips: Shake off the noodle flour so the broth does not become cloudy.
Sprinkling a little pepper makes it clean-tasting.

dak-soy-bokkeum.desc: Chicken stir-fry in a sweet and savory soy sauce glaze.
dak-soy-bokkeum.name: Soy Sauce Glazed Chicken (Dak-soy-bokkeum)
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and marinate for 10 minutes with 1 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp minced garlic, and black pepper. Cut the onion into thick strips, and slice diagonally the green onion and the Cheongyang chili.
Heat 1 tbsp cooking oil in a pan over medium heat, place the chicken skin-side down and cook for 3 minutes, then flip and cook for 3 more minutes to brown the outside.
Add the onion and stir-fry for 2 minutes; once the onion becomes translucent, add 2 tbsp soy sauce and 1 sugar, and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add green onion and Cheongyang chili, stir-fry for 1 minute, then drizzle in 1 tsp sesame oil and mix. Cut a piece open to check that the inside of the chicken has cooked white.
tips: The sauce burns easily, so turn the heat down to medium-low after adding the sugar.
Adding 1 tbsp (about 6g) Korean red pepper flakes makes it a spicy drinking snack.

dakdoritang.name: Spicy Braised Chicken (Dakdoritang)
steps: Blanch the chicken in boiling water for 2 minutes, then rinse in cold water to remove fat and impurities, cut the potato and carrot into large chunks (4cm), cut the onion into quarters, and slice diagonally the green onion.
Dissolve 2 tbsp of gochujang, 2 tbsp of Korean red pepper flakes, 3 tbsp of soy sauce, 1 tbsp of sugar, 1 tbsp of minced garlic, and 600ml of water in a pot, add the chicken, and boil over high heat.
When it comes to a boil, reduce the heat to medium, simmer for 15 minutes, and add the potato and carrot.
Cover with a lid and simmer for 15 minutes longer; once a chopstick easily pierces the potato, add the onion and braise for 5~10 minutes.
Add the green onion and boil for 2 minutes longer to finish, stirring occasionally so it doesn't stick to the bottom.
tips: Add 1 sliced Cheongyang chili pepper diagonally for a spicy kick.
Mix rice into the remaining broth for a perfect finish.

dakgaejang.desc: A spicy soup made with shredded chicken breast.
dakgaejang.name: Spicy Chicken Soup (Dakgaejang)
steps: Put 1.2L water and chicken breast in a pot, boil for 15 minutes, take out, and shred along the grain. Keep the broth as is.
Cut green onion into 6cm and fiddlehead fern to 5cm.

In a pan, stir-fry 1 tbsp sesame oil, 2 tbsp Korean red pepper flakes, and minced garlic over low heat for 1 minute, add the shredded chicken, fiddlehead fern, and green onion, and toss for 2 minutes.
Transfer to the broth, add 2 tbsp soup soy sauce, boil for 10 minutes, then add mung bean sprout and boil for 2 more minutes.
tips: Chicken breast gets tough if boiled too long, so 15 minutes is enough.
Do not throw away the boiled broth and use it as is.

dakgalbi.desc: A spicy stir-fry with chicken, cabbage, and sweet potato.
dakgalbi.name: Spicy Stir-Fried Chicken (Dakgalbi)
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and marinate with 2 tbsp gochujang, 1 tbsp Korean red pepper flakes, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp minced garlic, 1 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp sesame oil, and black pepper for 20 minutes.

Cut the cabbage into bite-sized pieces, slice the onion into thick strips, cut the sweet potato into 0.7 cm-thick half-moons, and slice the green onion and Cheongyang chili diagonally. If you microwave the sweet potato for 2 minutes first, it will cook faster.
Heat a wide pan over medium heat, add 1 tbsp cooking oil, and stir-fry the sweet potato and onion for 2 minutes.
Add the marinated chicken and 2 tbsp (30 ml) water, cover with a lid, and cook for 5 minutes. The chicken is ready when its outside turns white.

Add the cabbage and stir-fry without a lid for 5 to 6 minutes while stirring. Once the chicken is completely cooked and the cabbage has wilted, add the green onion and Cheongyang chili and stir-fry for 1 minute.
tips: The seasoning burns easily, so keep the heat at medium and stir frequently.
You can make fried rice by stir-frying rice and seaweed flakes in the leftover sauce when you finish eating.

dakgangjeong.desc: Bite-sized sweet crispy chicken tossed in a sweet and savory sauce.
dakgangjeong.name: Sweet Crispy Chicken (Dakgangjeong)
steps: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces, season lightly with salt 1/3 tsp, and coat with starch 5 tbsp.
Fry in cooking oil at 170°C for 5 minutes, remove, and fry again at 180°C for 1 minute.
Add soy sauce 2 tbsp, oligosaccharide syrup 3 tbsp, sugar 1 tbsp, and minced garlic to a pan and simmer on low heat for 1 minute.
Add the fried chicken and mixed nuts and toss together.
tips: Press the starch firmly onto the chicken to make it crispy.
Do not reduce the sauce all at once; toss the chicken as soon as it starts bubbling.

dakgomtang-simple.desc: A clear, nourishing chicken soup simmered for a long time.
dakgomtang-simple.name: Chicken Bone Soup (Dakgomtang)
steps: Rinse chicken in cold water and remove fat chunks.

Put chicken, 2L water, 1 green onion, and 1 tbsp minced garlic in a pot, boil over high heat, and when it boils, simmer over medium-low heat for 40 minutes. Skim off the foam that floats to the surface in between.
Take out the chicken, pull the meat apart into shreds, and put it back into the broth.
Season with 1 tsp salt, top with thinly sliced remaining green onion, and sprinkle black pepper.
tips: Skim off the foam and fat while boiling to keep the broth clear.
It is good to adjust salt individually right before eating.

dakjuk.desc: Nourishing porridge simmered thoroughly with chicken and glutinous rice.
dakjuk.name: Chicken Porridge (Dakjuk)
steps: Soak the glutinous rice for 30 minutes.
In a pot, put the chicken, 1.5 L of water, and green onion, boil for 30 minutes, then take out the chicken, shred the meat, and shred.
Add the soaked glutinous rice and finely minced carrot to the broth and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes while stirring.
Add the shredded chicken meat and 1 tsp of salt, boil for 5 minutes, and drizzle with sesame oil.
tips: Stir frequently so the bottom does not burn.
Porridge gets thicker as it cools, so add a little more water to adjust the consistency.

dallae-doenjang-jjigae.desc: Spring doenjang stew highlighting the fragrance of wild chive.
dallae-doenjang-jjigae.name: Wild Chive Doenjang Stew (Dallae Doenjang Jjigae)
steps: Trim the wild chive, cut into 3cm lengths, and cut the Korean zucchini, onion, and tofu into bite-sized pieces.
Dissolve doenjang 2 tbsp in water 500ml in a pot and bring to a boil.
Add the onion, Korean zucchini, and minced garlic, and boil for 7 minutes.
Add the tofu, boil for 3 more minutes, and add the wild chive right before turning off the heat.
tips: Add the wild chive at the end to preserve its aroma.
Sifting the doenjang through a strainer makes the broth clean.

dallae-ganjang.desc: A seasoned soy sauce with wild chives, perfect for mixing into rice.
dallae-ganjang.name: Wild Chive Soy Sauce Seasoning (Dallae Ganjang)
steps: Peel the outer skin of the wild chive roots, wash, drain, and slice thinly.
Mix soy sauce 4 tbsp, Korean red pepper flakes 1 tbsp, minced garlic, and sesame oil 1 tbsp.
Add the wild chive and sesame seeds, and mix well.
Serve alongside rice, tofu, or roasted seaweed.
tips: The small bulbs of the wild chive are spicy and fragrant, so mince them together.
It also goes well with tofu, fried eggs, or seaweed.

damyang-tteokgalbi.desc: Grilled tteokgalbi made by shaping minced beef and pork.
damyang-tteokgalbi.name: Damyang-style Grilled Short Rib Patties (Damyang Tteokgalbi)
steps: Finely mince onion, squeeze out the water, and knead it with beef, pork, soy sauce 3 tbsp, sugar 1 tbsp, minced garlic, sesame oil, and black pepper until sticky.
Divide into 4 portions, shape into thick oval patties, and press the center.
Coat a pan with cooking oil 1 tbsp, cook on medium-low heat for 7 minutes on each side until cooked through.
Brush with leftover sauce or soy sauce, grill for 1 more minute, and serve with cooked rice.
tips: Knead sufficiently so the shape does not fall apart when grilling.
Be sure to check if it is cooked through to the center.

danggeun-bokkeum.name: Sautéed Carrots (Danggeun Bokkeum)
steps: Cut the carrot into thin 5cm-long strips.
Coat a pan over medium heat with 1 tbsp of cooking oil and sauté the carrot for 4 minutes.
Add 1/3 tsp of salt and stir-fry for 2 more minutes.
Add 1 tsp of sesame oil and sesame seeds, and mix well.
tips: Carrots should be sautéed in oil for better nutrient absorption.
Stir-frying them too long makes them mushy, so turn off the heat while they still have a slight crunch.

danhobak-gui.desc: Crispy on the outside and tender on the inside kabocha squash made in an air fryer.
danhobak-gui.name: Roasted Kabocha Squash (Danhobak-gui)
steps: Scoop out the seeds from the kabocha squash and cut it into 1.5 cm thick slices with the skin on.
In a bowl, mix the kabocha squash with 1 tsp olive oil, 1/4 tsp salt, and black pepper.
Place them in the air fryer basket without overlapping, cook at 180°C for 8 minutes, flip, and cook for 5 more minutes.
Take them out when a chopstick goes through easily.
tips: If the slices are thick, increase the time by 2 minutes.
Brushing with 1 tsp oligosaccharide makes it sweeter.

danhobak-juk.desc: A smooth kabocha squash porridge without glutinous rice flour.
danhobak-juk.name: Sweet Pumpkin Porridge (Danhobak Juk)
steps: Scoop out the seeds from kabocha squash, peel off the skin, and cut it into 2cm pieces.
In a pot, add kabocha squash and water 400ml, and boil over medium heat for 15 minutes until thoroughly tender.
Add cooked rice and milk 100ml, and blend smoothly using a hand blender or masher.
Simmer for 5 more minutes over low heat while stirring, and season with salt 1/3tsp and sugar 1tsp.
tips: Adding cooked rice makes it thick without needing rice flour.
If it's too thick, add 50ml more of water or milk.

danhobak-salad.desc: A salad made by tossing sweet kabocha squash with yogurt.
danhobak-salad.name: Sweet Pumpkin Salad (Danhobak Salad)
steps: Scoop out the seeds from kabocha squash, cut it into 2cm pieces with the skin on, place it in a microwave-safe bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave for 5 minutes.
When a chopstick goes through easily, peel off the skin and mash it coarsely with a fork.
Add yogurt 3tbsp, salt 1/4tsp, and black pepper, then mix.
Transfer to a bowl and top with finely crushed mixed nuts.
tips: If kabocha squash is too hard, microwave it for 1 minute first to make it easier to cut.
Replacing with mayonnaise is more savory but increases the calories.

danhobak-soup.desc: Sweet and creamy kabocha squash soup.
danhobak-soup.name: Kabocha Squash Soup (Danhobak Soup)
steps: Remove the seeds from the kabocha squash, cut it into bite-sized pieces with the skin on, steam it in a steamer for 12 minutes, and peel off the skin.
Finely chop the onion and stir-fry it in 1 tbsp butter for 3 minutes.
Blend the kabocha squash, onion, 300 ml milk, and 100 ml water smoothly in a blender, then transfer to a pot.
Heat over low heat for 5 minutes and season with 1/3 tsp salt.
tips: Microwaving for 5 minutes makes the kabocha squash much easier to cut.
You can also top it with croutons.

danmuji-muchim.desc: Sweet, sour, and spicy pickled radish side dish just like the ones from snack bars.
danmuji-muchim.name: Seasoned Pickled Radish (Danmuji Muchim)
steps: Rinse the pickled yellow radish once in water to remove excess saltiness, place in a strainer to drain, and squeeze out the moisture. Cut into 1 cm pieces.
In a bowl, toss the pickled yellow radish with 1 tbsp of Korean red pepper flakes, 1/2 tbsp of sugar, and minced garlic.
Add 1 tsp of sesame oil and sesame seeds, and mix lightly.
Let sit in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to absorb the seasoning before serving.
tips: If the pickled yellow radish is too salty, soak it in cold water for 10 minutes.
Adding sliced green onion enhances the aroma.

dasima-myeolchi-yuksu.desc: A basic all-purpose broth used for soups, stews, and noodles.
dasima-myeolchi-yuksu.name: Anchovy and Kelp Broth (Dasima Myeolchi Yuksu)
steps: Remove the entrails from anchovy, and dry-roast in a dry pan over medium heat for 1 min to get rid of any fishy smell.
Put water 1.5 L, Korean radish, anchovy, and kombu in a pot and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the water starts to boil, remove kombu after 5 min. Boiling it too long can make it slimy.
Add green onion, simmer over medium heat for another 10 min, strain through a fine mesh strainer, and let cool.
tips: Store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or in the freezer for a month.
Freezing the broth in an ice cube tray is very convenient.

deodeok-gui.desc: Fragrant deodeok roots grilled with a spicy gochujang seasoning.
deodeok-gui.name: Grilled Deodeok (Deodeok Gui)
steps: Peel deodeok, soak in saltwater for 10 minutes to remove the bitterness, and flatten with a mallet.
Brush with 1 tbsp sesame oil and pan-fry over medium-low heat for 2 minutes on each side as a first cook.
Mix 2 tbsp gochujang, Korean red pepper flakes, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, and minced garlic to make the sauce, then brush it on.
Grill over medium-low heat for 2 minutes on each side and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
tips: The sauce burns easily, so apply it toward the end of cooking.
You can also grill it with just a pinch of salt to enjoy its natural aroma.

deulkkae-kalguksu.desc: Knife-cut noodle soup boiled savory with perilla seed powder.
deulkkae-kalguksu.name: Perilla Seed Knife-Cut Noodle Soup (Deulkkae-kalguksu)
steps: Cut the potato and Korean zucchini into thin strips, and tear the mushroom into bite-sized pieces.
Put water 800ml and the potato in a pot and boil for 5 minutes.
Shake off the knife-cut wheat noodles and boil them for 5 minutes together with the Korean zucchini and mushroom.
Add perilla seed powder 4 tbsp, soup soy sauce 1 tbsp, and salt 1/3 tsp, and boil for 2 more minutes.
tips: Add the perilla seeds at the end so the savory aroma remains.
As the potato breaks down, the broth becomes thick.

deulkkae-mu-guk.desc: A thick, comforting radish soup enriched with nutty perilla seed powder.
deulkkae-mu-guk.name: Perilla Seed Radish Soup (Deulkkae Mu Guk)
steps: Cut Korean radish into 0.5 cm thick flat pieces and slice thinly green onion.
Heat 1 tbsp perilla oil in a pot and sauté Korean radish over medium heat for 3 minutes until the edges turn translucent.
Pour 700 ml water, bring to a boil, and simmer over medium heat for 12 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp perilla seed powder, minced garlic, 1 tbsp soup soy sauce, and 1/3 tsp salt, boil for 5 minutes, then add green onion.
tips: Add perilla seed powder at the end to prevent a bitter taste.
Sautéing 100 g beef together makes it more hearty.

doenjang-gamja-guk.desc: A comforting soybean paste soup made simply with potatoes and onions.
doenjang-gamja-guk.name: Potato Doenjang Soup (Doenjang Gamja Guk)
steps: Cut the potato into half-moons 0.5cm thick, dice the onion, cut the tofu into 2cm cubes, and slice the green onion thinly.
Put water 600 ml and anchovy in a pot, simmer for 5 minutes once it boils, then remove the anchovy.
Dissolve doenjang 1 and 1/2 tbsp and add the potato, boiling over medium heat for 8 minutes. The potatoes should be cooked until translucent.
Add the onion, minced garlic, and tofu, boil for 4 minutes, then add the green onion and boil for another 1 minute.
tips: Sifting the doenjang through a strainer gives a clean soup without sediment.
Adding 1/6 Korean zucchini (about 50g) adds sweetness.

doenjang-stew.desc: The staple of home-cooked meals, made with whatever vegetables you have.
doenjang-stew.name: Soybean Paste Stew (Doenjang-jjigae)
steps: Cut the potato into 0.7cm half-moons, the Korean zucchini into 0.5cm half-moons, dice the onion, cut the tofu into 2cm cubes, and cut the green onion diagonally.
Put 400ml of water and the anchovy into a pot, and when it starts to boil, simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes. Take out the anchovy.
Dissolve 2 tbsp of doenjang through a fine-mesh strainer (or using a spoon) into the pot, add the potato first, and boil for 5 minutes. It is ready when the potato is half-cooked.
Add the onion and Korean zucchini and boil for 4 more minutes. Add the minced garlic and Korean red pepper flakes.
Add the tofu and green onion, boil for 3 minutes, and then taste the stew. If it is bland, add 1 tsp (about 6g) of doenjang at a time.
tips: If you don't have anchovy, you can make a savory broth using 400ml of rice water.
Don't add all the doenjang at once; add it gradually while tasting.

dog-apple-yogurt-pop.desc: A refreshing snack made with cored apples and unsweetened yogurt.
dog-apple-yogurt-pop.name: Dog Apple Yogurt Pop (Gangaji Sagwa Yogeoteu Pop)
steps: Completely remove the seeds and core from the apple and mince it finely with the skin on.
Mix the yogurt and the minced apple.
Divide and pour into 6 compartments of a small silicone mold or ice cube tray.
Freeze in the freezer for 3 hours and give 1 compartment a day.
tips: Apple seeds are toxic, so be sure to remove them.
Give only a small amount to pets with lactose intolerance.

dog-beef-veg-stew.desc: Beef soup simmered without any seasonings.
dog-beef-veg-stew.name: Dog Beef Vegetable Soup
steps: Wipe the blood off the beef, cut it finely into 0.5 cm sizes, and chop the carrot, sweet potato, and broccoli to the same size.
Put 500ml of water and beef in a pot, and when it starts to boil, skim off the foam.
Add the carrot and sweet potato, and simmer over medium-low heat for 15 minutes.
Add the broccoli, boil for 5 more minutes, let cool, divide into 3 portions, and feed.
tips: Never add salt, soy sauce, or onions.
It is also good to pour just the broth over rice.

dog-bugeo-treat.desc: A protein snack made by soaking unsalted dried pollack and baking it.
dog-bugeo-treat.name: Dog Dried Pollack Treat (Gangaji Bugeo Teurit)
steps: Since dried pollack contains salt, soak it in 300 ml of cold water for 30 minutes, drain, change the water once, and soak for another 15 minutes.
Squeeze out the water firmly with your hands, check for bones, and cut it into 3 cm lengths.
Place them in the air fryer basket without overlapping and dry at 100 degrees for 15 minutes.
After cooling, give one or two pieces a day.
tips: Dried pollack has sodium, so make sure to soak it at least twice.
Remove all bones so they don't get stuck.

dog-chicken-cookie.desc: Crunchy cookies made with unsalted chicken breast and oatmeal.
dog-chicken-cookie.name: Dog Chicken Breast Cookies
steps: Boil chicken breast in 200ml of boiling water for 10 minutes until fully cooked, let it cool, and finely grind or mince it.
Mix chicken breast, oatmeal, and egg to form a dough.
Shape into small portions, place on an oven sheet, and press flat.
Bake in a 170-degree oven or air fryer for 15 minutes, let cool, and store.
tips: Never add seasonings, salt, onion, or garlic.
Store in the freezer and give only one or two a day.

dog-chicken-sweetpotato-jerky.desc: Homemade unsalted jerky and dried sweet potato treats.
dog-chicken-sweetpotato-jerky.name: Dog Chicken Breast and Sweet Potato Jerky
steps: Place the chicken breast in 600 ml of boiling water, boil for 10 minutes until cooked all the way through to the center. Take it out and let it cool.
Cut the boiled chicken breast thinly across the grain into 0.5cm thickness. Wash the sweet potato with the skin on and cut it into 0.5cm thickness.
Spread them out in the air fryer basket without overlapping and dry at 80 degrees for 90 minutes. Flip once halfway through.
It is done when it feels firm and snaps when bent by hand. Cool completely and store in an airtight container.
tips: Do not add any seasoning or salt at all.
Store in the freezer for up to 2 weeks, or feed within 3 days if kept in the refrigerator.

dog-chicken-veg-porridge.desc: A single serving of unsalted fresh-cooked food that is easy to digest.
dog-chicken-veg-porridge.name: Dog Chicken and Vegetable Porridge
steps: Cut the chicken breast into small cubes, and finely chop the carrot and broccoli to 0.5 cm size.
Put 400ml of water and chicken breast in a pot, and when it comes to a boil, cook over medium heat for 8 minutes.
Add the carrot, broccoli, and cooked brown rice, and simmer thoroughly over low heat for 15 minutes to make it soft.
Let it cool slightly, divide into 3 portions, and feed once a day. Please let it cool so it is not too hot.
tips: Cutting it small to fit the dog's size makes it easy to digest.
If you portion and freeze it, it can be stored for 2 weeks.

dog-duck-jerky.desc: Unsalted dried duck jerky (skin and fat removed).
dog-duck-jerky.name: Dog Duck Jerky (Gangaji Ori Yukpo)
steps: Remove all skin and fat from the duck.
Add the duck to 600 ml of boiling water and boil for 12 minutes until cooked all the way through.
Cool, slice thinly to 0.5 cm thickness, and place in the air fryer basket without overlapping.
Dry at 80 degrees for 90 minutes, remove when it snaps, and let it cool.
tips: Duck is high in fat, so be sure to remove the skin.
It can be stored in the freezer for up to 2 weeks.

dog-egg-sweetpotato-steam.desc: A simple and nutritious snack made in the microwave.
dog-egg-sweetpotato-steam.name: Dog Egg Sweet Potato Steam
steps: Peel the sweet potato, cut it into small pieces, put them in a heat-safe bowl, add 2 tbsp (30 ml) of water, and cover with plastic wrap.
Cook in the microwave for 3 minutes, then mash with a fork.
Beat 1 egg and mix with the mashed sweet potato.
Cover with plastic wrap, microwave for 2 minutes, check that the egg is fully cooked, cut into 4 pieces, and let cool.
tips: Make sure the egg is fully cooked all the way through for safety.
Omit the egg if your dog has allergies.

dog-pumpkin-oat-cookie.desc: Homemade cookies baked without sugar or butter.
dog-pumpkin-oat-cookie.name: Dog Kabocha Squash Oatmeal Cookie
steps: Peel the kabocha squash, microwave it for 4 minutes to cook, and then mash it finely with a fork.
In a bowl, mix the mashed kabocha squash, 50g of oatmeal, and 1 egg to make a dough.
Scoop the dough by 1 tsp each, flatten it into 3 cm diameter circles, and place on parchment paper.
Bake in an oven or air fryer preheated to 160 degrees for 18 minutes, let cool, and serve.
tips: Sugar is not added because the sweetness of the kabocha squash is enough.
Feeding too much is high in calories, so give only 1-2 a day.

dog-pumpkin-pudding.desc: Soft, unsweetened steamed kabocha squash pudding.
dog-pumpkin-pudding.name: Dog Kabocha Squash Pudding
steps: Remove skin and seeds from kabocha squash, steam for 12 minutes, and mash finely.
Mix egg 1 and soy milk 100ml, combine with mashed kabocha squash, and strain through a sieve.
Divide into 6 small containers and steam over low heat for 12 minutes.
Let it cool and give only 1 a day.
tips: Never add sugar or salt.
Substitute with water if soy milk doesn't agree with your pet.

dog-salmon-potato-bite.desc: Salmon and potato snack rich in Omega-3.
dog-salmon-potato-bite.name: Dog Salmon Potato Bite
steps: Remove bones and skin from the salmon, and boil in 300ml of boiling water for 6 minutes to cook thoroughly to the center. Peel and boil the potato, then mash it.
Check that the boiled salmon has no bones and mash it finely with a fork.
Mix the mashed potato, salmon, and 20g of oatmeal, and shape into 2 cm diameter balls.
Bake in a 170-degree air fryer for 10 minutes, let cool completely, and serve.
tips: Be sure to remove fish bones.
Give only a very small amount of salmon and check the reaction first.

dog-sweetpotato-chew.desc: A healthy chewy snack made by baking and drying.
dog-sweetpotato-chew.name: Dog Sweet Potato Chew (Kangaji Goguma Mallangi)
steps: Wash the sweet potato clean with the skin on and cut it into 0.7cm thick slices.
Place them in the air fryer basket without overlapping.
Dry at 80°C for 60 minutes, flip them, and dry for another 40 minutes.
Press with your hand, and when chewy, take them out, cool, put in an airtight container, and give 1~2 pieces a day.
tips: Do not give too much as it contains sugar.
Cut into small pieces for small dogs.

dog-tofu-chicken-ball.name: Dog Tofu Chicken Ball
steps: Wrap the tofu in a cotton cloth to squeeze out all the moisture, and finely chop the chicken breast or grind it in a food processor. Finely chop the carrot.
Put all of the tofu, chicken breast, egg, carrot, and oatmeal into a bowl and knead until sticky.
Form 10 balls with a 2 cm diameter.
Bake in a 170-degree air fryer for 12 minutes or boil in boiling water for 5 minutes until fully cooked through to the center. Let cool and serve.
tips: Raw chicken is dangerous, so be sure to cook it all the way through.
Cut it in half for small dogs.

dog-yogurt-banana-ice.desc: A refreshing frozen treat for hot days (use plain unsweetened yogurt only).
dog-yogurt-banana-ice.name: Dog Yogurt Banana Ice
steps: Mash the banana finely with a fork.
Mix 100 g of yogurt with the mashed banana.
Divide evenly into 6 compartments of an ice cube tray.
Freeze in the freezer for 3 hours and feed 1 cube a day.
tips: If your dog is lactose intolerant, feed only a small amount or avoid it.
Check store-bought yogurt carefully for sugar or xylitol.

dongdaemun-dakhanmari.desc: A dish where a whole chicken is boiled with potatoes and dipped in a garlic-chive sauce.
dongdaemun-dakhanmari.name: Dongdaemun Whole Chicken Stew (Dongdaemun Dakhanmari)
steps: Rinse chicken in cold water, remove excess fat, and place in a pot with 2L of water, green onion, and minced garlic to boil.
Once it comes to a boil, skim off the foam, simmer over medium heat for 30 minutes, add potato, and boil for 15 minutes.
Mix 3 tbsp of soy sauce, 2 tbsp of vinegar, and mustard to make the dipping sauce.
Dip chicken and potato into the sauce to eat, and finish by adding knife-cut wheat noodles to boil for 5 minutes.
tips: Boiling the potato thoroughly will make the broth thick.
Adding knife-cut wheat noodles to the remaining broth is the standard way to finish.

donggeurangttaeng.desc: Savory pan-fried patties made by shaping pork, tofu, and vegetables into rounds.
donggeurangttaeng.name: Pan-Fried Meat Pancakes (Donggeurangttaeng)
steps: Squeeze all the moisture out of the tofu and mash it, and finely mince the onion and carrot.
Combine the pork, tofu, vegetable, salt 1/3 tsp, and black pepper, and knead well until sticky.
Shape into 4 cm wide rounds, coat in Korean pancake mix, and dip in beaten egg 2 beaten.
Heat cooking oil 2 tbsp in a pan over medium heat and pan-fry both sides for 3 minutes each until golden and cooked through.
tips: Cook slowly over low heat so the inside cooks thoroughly.
You can also freeze them and reheat to eat later.

dongnae-pajeon.desc: Crispy Dongnae-style savory pancake loaded with thin green onions and seafood.
dongnae-pajeon.name: Dongnae Green Onion Pancake (Dongnae Pajeon)
steps: Cut thin green onion to the pan's length and slice seafood into bite-sized pieces, then wipe off moisture.
Mix 1/2 cup of Korean pancake mix, 100 ml of water, and 1/4 tsp of salt to make a thin batter.
Drizzle cooking oil in a pan, lay down thin green onion, pour the batter over, top with seafood, and cook over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Beat 2 eggs, pour on top, flip, and cook for 3 more minutes until crispy.
tips: Laying the thin green onion neatly makes the shape look pretty.
Mixing in rice flour instead of Korean pancake mix makes it chewier.

dongtae-jeon.desc: Savory pan-fried pollack fillets, a holiday favorite.
dongtae-jeon.name: Pan-Fried Pollack Fillets (Dongtae-jeon)
steps: Thaw the frozen pollack fillets, pat them dry thoroughly with a paper towel, and sprinkle with 1/3 tsp of salt and black pepper, then let rest for 10 minutes.
Lightly coat both sides with flour and shake off the excess.
Beat the eggs and coat the fillets.
Place them in a pan with cooking oil over medium-low heat and fry until golden for 3 minutes on each side.
tips: Patting the fish dry prevents the egg coating from peeling off.
Keep it on medium-low heat so they don't burn.

dongtae-jjigae.desc: A spicy and hearty pollack stew cooked with Korean radish and tofu.
dongtae-jjigae.name: Spicy Pollack Stew (Dongtae-jjigae)
steps: Thaw the frozen pollack, cut it into bite-sized pieces, and wash. Slice the Korean radish into square chunks, and cut the tofu and Korean zucchini into thick slices.
Put 800 ml of water and Korean radish in a pot and boil for 10 minutes.
Dissolve 2 tbsp of Korean red pepper flakes, 1 tbsp of soup soy sauce, and 1 tbsp of minced garlic into the broth, add the frozen pollack, and boil for 8 minutes.
Add the tofu and Korean zucchini, boil for another 5 minutes, and top with green onion.
tips: Skim off the foam for a clean broth.
Adding crown daisy on top gives it a great aroma.

donkatsu.desc: Crispy pork cutlet coated in breadcrumbs and deep-fried.
donkatsu.name: Pork Cutlet (Donkatsu)
steps: Pound the pork with the back of a knife or a meat mallet to a thickness of 0.8 cm, make minor incisions, and season with 1/3 tsp of salt and black pepper.
Coat in flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs in that order, pressing the breadcrumbs down firmly with your hand.

Pour cooking oil into a frying pan to a depth of 3 cm, heat to 170°C, and fry the pork for 3 minutes on each side until golden. The right temperature is when a piece of breadcrumb floats right back up.
Place on a paper towel to drain excess oil, let cool for 5 minutes, and slice. Serve with a sauce made by mixing 2 tbsp of ketchup, 1 tsp of soy sauce, and 1 tsp of sugar.
tips: If the oil temperature is too low, the breadcrumbs will fall off. Start on high heat, and maintain medium heat after adding the cutlet.
You can also spray with cooking oil and cook in an air fryer at 190°C for 12 minutes.

doraji-muchim.desc: Sweet, sour, and spicy seasoned bellflower root.
doraji-muchim.name: Seasoned Bellflower Root (Doraji-muchim)
steps: Tear or cut the bellflower root into thin strips, add salt 1 tsp, and massage for 5 minutes to remove the bitterness.
Rinse in cold water 3 times, blanch in boiling water for 20 seconds, cool in cold water, and squeeze out the water firmly.
Mix gochujang 1 tbsp, Korean red pepper flakes 1/2 tbsp, vinegar 1 tbsp, sugar 1/2 tbsp, minced garlic, and sesame oil to make the seasoning.
Add the bellflower root, toss to mix, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
tips: If the bitterness is strong, massage it in salt one more time and rinse.
Adding water dropwort enhances the aroma.

dotorimuk-muchim.desc: Acorn jelly tossed in a sweet and tangy seasoned soy sauce.
dotorimuk-muchim.name: Acorn Jelly Salad (Dotorimuk Muchim)
steps: Cut the acorn jelly into bite-sized pieces, and slice thinly the cucumber and onion.
Make the sauce by mixing soy sauce 2 tbsp, Korean red pepper flakes 1 tbsp, vinegar 1 tbsp, sugar 1 tsp, sesame oil 1 tbsp, and minced garlic.
Place the acorn jelly and vegetables on a plate, pour the sauce over them, and toss gently.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
tips: Toss gently so the acorn jelly doesn't break.
It tastes even better served with kimchi.

dubu-buchim.desc: Pan-fried tofu with a savory seasoned soy sauce topping.
dubu-buchim.name: Pan-Fried Tofu (Dubu-buchim)
steps: Slice the tofu 1cm thick, place it on paper towels, and remove moisture for 5 minutes. Evenly sprinkle 1/3 tsp of salt on both sides.
Mix 2 tbsp of soy sauce, Korean red pepper flakes, minced garlic, green onion, sesame oil, sesame seeds, and 1 tbsp of water to make the sauce.
Heat 2 tbsp of cooking oil in a pan over medium heat, place the tofu without overlapping, and fry for 3 to 4 minutes until the bottom is golden brown, then flip.
Fry the other side for 3 minutes and place on paper towels to drain the oil.
Place the tofu on a plate and top with the sauce to serve.
tips: Removing moisture thoroughly prevents oil from splattering and makes it crispy.
Coating it lightly in pancake mix and then dipping in egg wash makes it tofujeon.

dubu-duruchigi.desc: Tofu and kimchi stir-fried and braised in a spicy sauce.
dubu-duruchigi.name: Spicy Braised Tofu (Dubu Duruchigi)
steps: Cut tofu into thick slices, slice pork and kimchi into bite-sized pieces, and cut onion into thin strips.
In a pan, stir-fry pork, kimchi, 1 tbsp Korean red pepper flakes, minced garlic, and 1 tbsp soy sauce for 3 minutes.
Add onion and 100 ml water, place tofu on top, and braise over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Top with green onion.
tips: Tofu breaks easily, so don't stir it; instead, spoon the broth over it.
Adding instant ramen noodles is also delicious.

dubu-gangjeong.desc: Sweet and salty tofu pan-fried until crispy with a starch coating.
dubu-gangjeong.name: Crispy Glazed Tofu (Dubu Gangjeong)
steps: Wrap tofu in paper towels and press for 10 minutes to remove moisture, then cut into 2.5 cm cubes.
Coat tofu evenly with 3 tbsp starch and shake off excess.
Heat 3 tbsp cooking oil in a pan over medium heat, roll tofu around, and fry all 6 sides for 1 minute 30 seconds each until crispy.
In another pan, combine 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oligosaccharide syrup, 1 tbsp ketchup, and minced garlic, simmer over low heat for 1 minute, toss tofu in it, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
tips: You must remove the moisture from tofu thoroughly for it to be crispy.
You can also bake in an air fryer at 190 degrees for 12 minutes and toss with the sauce.

duck-bibim-guksu.desc: Chewy noodles tossed in a sweet and sour sauce topped with smoked duck.
duck-bibim-guksu.name: Spicy Smoked Duck Noodles (Duck Bibim Guksu)
steps: Cook smoked duck in a pan without oil over medium heat for 3 minutes, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Boil thin wheat noodles in boiling water for 3 minutes, rinse in cold water to drain, and cut cucumber into thin strips.
Mix gochujang 2 tbsp, vinegar 1 tbsp, sugar 1 tbsp, and sesame oil 1 tbsp to make the sauce.
Toss thin wheat noodles with the sauce, and top with cucumber, smoked duck, and sesame seeds.
tips: Cooking smoked duck in a pan to render the fat makes it less greasy.
Adding kimchi to the sauce makes it refreshing.

duck-garlic-pasta.desc: Aglio e olio infused with the rich flavor of smoked duck.
duck-garlic-pasta.name: Smoked Duck Garlic Pasta
steps: Add salt 1 tsp to 1.5L of boiling water and cook spaghetti for 8 minutes, reserving 1/2 cup (100ml) of pasta water.
Cut smoked duck into bite-sized pieces, stir-fry in a pan without oil for 3 minutes, and set aside.
In the same pan, stir-fry olive oil 3 tbsp and minced garlic over low heat for 1 minute.
Add spaghetti, pasta water 3 tbsp, and smoked duck, stir-fry for 1 minute and 30 seconds, and sprinkle with black pepper.
tips: Since duck fat renders out, you can reduce the olive oil.
Stir-fry the garlic over low heat so it doesn't burn.

duck-gyeran-mal.desc: Savory rolled omelet made with smoked duck and egg.
duck-gyeran-mal.name: Smoked Duck Rolled Omelet (Duck Gyeran Mali)
steps: Mince smoked duck finely and slice green onion thinly.
Mix egg 4, salt 1/4 tsp, minced smoked duck, and green onion.
Grease a pan with cooking oil and pour a thin layer of egg mixture over low heat, rolling it up, and repeat 3 times.
Let it cool and cut into thick pieces.
tips: Since smoked duck is already seasoned, reduce the salt.
Keep the heat low so it doesn't burn.

dumpling-soup.desc: A simple soup made with frozen dumplings.
dumpling-soup.name: Dumpling Soup (Mandu-guk)
steps: Boil 600 ml of water in a pot, add 1 tbsp of soy sauce, and minced garlic. Slice thinly the green onion.
Add dumpling and boil on medium heat for 5~6 minutes. They are done when they float to the top and become translucent.
Beat an egg, drizzle it in in a thin circle, leave it untouched for 30 seconds, and then stir it once.
Season with a pinch of salt and black pepper, and top with green onion.
tips: Adding 100g of sliced rice cake makes it rice cake and dumpling soup.
Boiling 5 dried anchovies together deepens the broth flavor.

duruchigi.desc: A lightly soupy stir-fry of kimchi and pork.
duruchigi.name: Spicy Pork and Kimchi Stir-Fry (Duruchigi)
steps: Marinate the pork with 1 tbsp Korean red pepper flakes, 1 tbsp gochujang, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1/2 tbsp sugar, and 1 tbsp minced garlic for 10 minutes.
Cut the kimchi into 4 cm pieces, slice the onion into thin strips, slice the green onion diagonally, and rinse the soybean sprout.
Layer the soybean sprout, onion, and kimchi in a wide pan, place the marinated pork on top, and pour 100 ml water.
Cover with a lid and cook over medium heat for 8 minutes, then remove the lid, toss, and stir-fry for 5 more minutes.
Add the green onion and 1 tbsp sesame oil, stir-fry for 1 more minute, and finish.
tips: The soybean sprout releases water, so do not add too much water at first.
It is delicious wrapped in lettuce leaves along with rice.

dwaeji-bulgogi.name: Spicy Pork Bulgogi (Dwaeji Bulgogi)
steps: Combine the pork with soy sauce 3 tbsp, sugar 1 tbsp, minced garlic 1 tbsp, sesame oil 1 tbsp, mirin 1 tbsp, and black pepper, and marinate for 15 minutes.
Cut the onion into thin strips and slice the green onion diagonally.
Heat cooking oil 1 tbsp in a pan over high heat, spread out the pork, and sear without flipping for 2 minutes. Once the bottom turns brown, flip it over.
Add the onion and stir-fry for 3 minutes, and when the onion becomes translucent, add the green onion and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Finish by sprinkling sesame seeds.
tips: Cooking the meat without disturbing it at first lets the marinade caramelize deliciously.
Adding gochujang 1 tbsp (about 20g) turns it into a spicy bulgogi.

egg-drop-soup.desc: A simple soup made with egg and green onion in 10 min.
egg-drop-soup.name: Egg Drop Soup (Gyeran-guk)
steps: Slice the green onion thinly and beat 2 egg.
Put 500ml of water in a pot and bring to a boil. When it comes to a boil, add 1 tbsp of soy sauce and minced garlic and boil for 1 more min.
When the broth is boiling vigorously, pour the beaten egg in a thin circle and leave it undisturbed for 20 sec to set.
Stir once firmly, add the green onion, and season with 1/3 tsp of salt. Add sesame oil and black pepper, then turn off the heat.
tips: Pour the beaten egg over high heat so it sets in soft, fluffy bits.
Seasoning with 1/2 tsp (about 3ml) of salted fermented shrimp or anchovy fish sauce enhances the umami.

egg-fried-rice.desc: A 10-minute fried rice that only needs eggs and green onions.
egg-fried-rice.name: Egg Fried Rice (Gyeran Bokkeumbap)
steps: Slice thinly the green onion to a thickness of 0.5 cm, and microwave the cooked rice for 1 minute to break up any clumps.
Coat a pan heated over high heat with 1 tbsp of cooking oil and fry the green onion for 30 seconds to make scallion oil. It is ready when the edges of the green onion turn golden.
Push the green onion to one side, crack 2 eggs into the other side, stir vigorously with chopsticks to make a soft-boiled scramble for 30 seconds. Do not cook them completely.
Add cooked rice and press and separate it with a spatula, frying for 2 minutes so the eggs and grains of cooked rice are evenly mixed.
Drizzle 1 tsp of soy sauce around the edge of the pan to create a charred aroma, season with a pinch of salt and black pepper, and stir-fry for 30 seconds more.
Turn off the heat, drizzle 1/2 tsp of sesame oil, and mix.
tips: You need to stir-fry quickly over high heat so the grains of cooked rice scatter.
Using 1/2 tsp (about 3g) of oyster sauce instead of soy sauce gives it a Chinese restaurant taste.

egg-jangjorim.desc: A classic side dish of boiled eggs simmered in a savory soy sauce glaze.
egg-jangjorim.name: Braised Eggs (Gyeran-jangjorim)
steps: Pour enough cold water (about 1L) into a pot to submerge the egg, add a pinch of salt, and boil over high heat. When it starts boiling, reduce the heat to medium and boil for 10 minutes.
Immediately soak the boiled egg in cold water for 3 minutes to cool, then peel the shell. Slice the green onion and Cheongyang chili diagonally.
In another pot, add 300ml of water, 5 tbsp of soy sauce, 2 tbsp of sugar, 2 tbsp of mirin, and 1 tsp of minced garlic, and bring to a boil.
When it boils, add the egg, green onion, and Cheongyang chili, simmer over medium-low heat for 15 minutes, and roll the egg midway to coat the color evenly.
When about 1/3 of the broth is left, turn off the heat and let it cool as is so the flavor absorbs. It tastes even better if left overnight.
tips: You can store it in the refrigerator and eat it for 3 to 4 days.
If you add beef eye of round together, it becomes a meat jangjorim.

egg-porridge.desc: A gentle and comforting egg porridge.
egg-porridge.name: Egg Porridge
steps: Wash uncooked rice, soak in cold water for 30 minutes, then drain in a strainer. Mince carrot finely and slice thinly green onion.
Grease a pot with sesame oil 1 tsp and stir-fry the soaked rice over medium heat for 2 minutes until the rice grains become translucent.
Pour water 600ml, and when it starts boiling, reduce to low heat, cover with a lid, and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir occasionally so the bottom doesn't burn.
When the rice is fully soft, add carrot and simmer for 3 more minutes.
Pour in the beaten egg, leave it for 30 seconds without stirring, stir once, season with salt 1/3 tsp, and top with green onion.
tips: Stir-frying the rice before boiling makes the porridge more nutty and delicious.
If you make it with 1 bowl (210g) of leftover cooked rice, 15 minutes is enough.

egg-pudding-simple.desc: A soft and smooth pudding made with egg and milk.
egg-pudding-simple.name: Egg Pudding
steps: Beat 3 egg, then add 300 ml of milk and 3 tbsp of sugar, mix well, and strain through a sieve.
Divide the mixture into pudding cups or heat-resistant containers.
Place in a steamer and steam over low heat for 15 minutes. At this time, stick a chopstick into the lid to let the steam escape.
After cooling, let it set in the refrigerator for 2 hours until cold.
tips: Straining it through a sieve makes it smooth.
Steaming over high heat creates holes, so be sure to use low heat.

egg-ramen.desc: The easiest way to take ramen to the next level.
egg-ramen.name: Egg and Scallion Ramen
steps: Pour 550ml of water into a pot and bring it to a boil over high heat. Cut the green onion diagonally in advance.
When the water is boiling vigorously, add the ramen and soup base, and boil for 3 minutes.
Add the green onion and crack the egg right in the center without beating it. Do not touch it with chopsticks.
Cover the pot with a lid, reduce the heat to medium, and boil for 1 more minute. It is best when the egg white is set and white, and the yolk is soft-boiled.
Sprinkle with a pinch of black pepper and serve immediately.
tips: If you want the broth to be thick, beat the egg before adding it.
Using only 2/3 of the soup base reduces the saltiness (lowers sodium).

egg-salad.name: Egg Salad
steps: Boil egg for 10 minutes, cool in cold water, and peel.
Mash egg and mix with 2 tbsp mayonnaise, 1/4 tsp salt, and black pepper.
Place iceberg lettuce on a plate and top with egg salad.
Eat right away or serve with bread.
tips: Don't mash them completely; leave some chunks for a better texture.
It's also great served on bread.

egg-sandwich.desc: A sandwich filled with a creamy egg-mayo filling.
egg-sandwich.name: Egg Sandwich
steps: Put cold water and egg 3 in a pot and bring to a boil over high heat. When it starts boiling, reduce the heat to medium, boil for 10 minutes, cool in cold water, and peel the shells.
Put egg in a bowl, mash coarsely with a fork, and mix with mayonnaise 2 tbsp, salt 1/4 tsp, sugar 1/2 tsp, and black pepper.
Spread the egg filling evenly to a thickness of 1cm on 2 slices of sandwich bread.
Cover with the remaining 2 slices of sandwich bread, trim the edges with a knife, and cut in half.
tips: Spreading a thin layer of mayonnaise on the inside of the bread prevents the filling from soaking into the bread.
Toasting the sandwich bread in a dry pan adds a crispy texture.

egg-toast.name: Egg Toast (Gyeran-Toast)
steps: Cut the cabbage finely into 2mm wide strips and beat them together with 2 eggs and a pinch of salt.
Heat 1/2 tbsp of cooking oil in a pan over medium heat and toast two slices of sandwich bread on both sides for 1 minute each until golden.
Add the remaining oil to the same pan, pour the egg mixture in a round shape about the size of the sandwich bread (approx. 10cm), cook for 2 minutes, flip, and cook for 1 more minute.
Place the cooked egg on top of the sandwich bread, sprinkle with 1/2 tsp of sugar, cover with the other piece of bread, and cut in half.
tips: It tastes even better with a light spread of ketchup or mayonnaise.
Adding 1 slice of cheese turns it into a cheese egg toast.

egg-tofu-scramble.desc: A soft and filling scramble made with mashed tofu.
egg-tofu-scramble.name: Tofu Egg Scramble (Dubu-gyeran-seukreambeul)
steps: Wrap tofu with kitchen towels to squeeze out excess moisture completely, and crumble coarsely by hand. Slice green onion thinly.
In a bowl, combine 2 egg, salt 1/4 tsp, and black pepper, then beat well.
Heat cooking oil 1 tsp in a pan heated over medium heat, stir-fry tofu for 2 minutes to evaporate moisture.
Pour in green onion and the beaten egg mixture, and cook over low heat for 1 minute 30 seconds while stirring vigorously with a spatula. Turn off the heat when it is fluffy and half-cooked.
tips: You must squeeze the moisture out of tofu so it won't become soggy.
It is delicious on its own or paired with cooked brown rice or sandwich bread.

egg-veg-muffin.desc: An egg and vegetable dish baked in a muffin tin, great for lunchboxes.
egg-veg-muffin.name: Baked Egg and Vegetable Muffins (Gyeran Yachae Muffin)
steps: Cut bell pepper, onion, and spinach into small 0.5cm pieces. Tear cheese into small pieces.
In a bowl, beat 4 egg, 1/3 tsp salt, and black pepper, then mix in the chopped vegetables.
Lightly grease 4 compartments of a muffin tin with cooking oil and pour the egg mixture up to 80% full. Top with cheese.
Bake in an air fryer or oven preheated to 180 degrees for 13 minutes, and take them out when a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
tips: The egg mixture will puff up, so fill the tin only 80% full.
Once cooled, you can store them in the refrigerator for 2 days and reheat to eat.

eobok-jaengban.desc: A Pyongyang-style brass platter hot pot topped with sliced boiled beef and vegetables.
eobok-jaengban.name: Pyongyang Hot Pot Platter (Eobok Jaengban)
steps: Soak beef in cold water for 15 minutes to remove blood, boil in 1 L of water for 50 minutes, take it out, and slice thinly.
Cut mung bean sprout, water dropwort, mushroom, and napa cabbage into bite-sized pieces.
Season the broth with 2 tbsp of soup soy sauce and bring it to a rolling boil.
Cook beef and vegetables in a platter or hot pot, and dip them in a sauce made by mixing 2 tbsp of soy sauce and 1 tbsp of vinegar.
tips: Slice the meat thinly so it stays tender.
Add more water if the broth reduces.

eohyang-gaji.desc: Chinese-style eggplant stir-fry coated in a sweet and spicy sauce.
eohyang-gaji.name: Eggplant in Garlic Sauce (Eohyang-gaji)
steps: Cut eggplant into quarters lengthwise and slice into 5cm lengths, and mince green onion.
Add 3 tbsp of cooking oil to a pan and stir-fry eggplant over medium heat for 5 minutes until the outsides are golden and tender, then remove.
In the same pan, add green onion, minced garlic, and pork, stir-fry for 2 minutes, then add 1 tbsp of gochujang and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add 100 ml of water, 1 tbsp of soy sauce, 1 tbsp of sugar, and 1 tbsp of vinegar; once boiling, thicken with a mixture of 1 tsp of starch dissolved in 1 tbsp of water.
Add eggplant, toss for 1 minute, and finish.
tips: Stir-frying the eggplant first helps it absorb the sauce and stay chewy.
It is also great served over rice as a rice bowl.

eomuk-jorim.desc: Sweet and savory braised fish cakes.
eomuk-jorim.name: Braised Fish Cake (Eomuk-jorim)
steps: Blanch the fish cake in boiling water to remove excess oil and cut it into bite-sized pieces. Cut the onion into thin strips.
Put 100ml of water, 2 tbsp of soy sauce, 1 tbsp of sugar, and minced garlic into a pan and bring to a boil.
Add the fish cake and onion, and simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add 1 tbsp of oligosaccharide syrup and sesame seeds, and simmer for 1 more minute.
tips: Blanching the fish cake removes grease for a clean taste.
Adding Cheongyang pepper makes it spicy.

eomuk-udon.desc: Warm udon noodles with fish cake in a clean anchovy broth.
eomuk-udon.name: Fish Cake Udon (Eomuk Udon)
steps: Remove the entrails from the anchovy and dry-roast in a dry pan over medium heat for 1 minute to remove any fishy smell.
In a pot, combine 800 ml of water and the anchovy, bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to medium heat and simmer for 8 minutes before removing the anchovy.
Cut the fish cake into bite-sized pieces and slice the green onion diagonally.
Season the broth with 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp mirin, and 1/3 tsp salt, add the fish cake, and boil for 3 minutes.
Add the udon noodle and boil for 2 minutes to loosen. If using frozen noodles, thaw them before adding.
Top with green onion and black pepper, then turn off the heat.
tips: Overcooking the fish cake will make it mushy. 3 minutes is just right.
Using store-bought udon broth packs instead of anchovies makes it even easier.

eonyang-bulgogi.desc: Thin wire-rack bulgogi aged with Korean pear and soy sauce.
eonyang-bulgogi.name: Eonyang-style Bulgogi (Eonyang Bulgogi)
steps: Make the marinade by blending Korean pear and onion and mixing with 4 tbsp of soy sauce, 1 tbsp of sugar, minced garlic, sesame oil, and black pepper.
Toss the beef in the marinade and let it marinate for 1 hour.
Place the beef on a heated pan or wire rack and grill over high heat for 2 minutes on each side.
Top with sliced green onion and serve.
tips: You must grill thin meat quickly over high heat to keep the juices.
Serve with lettuce wraps.

fish-cake-soup.desc: A comforting soup that's great to boil in a single pot on a cold day.
fish-cake-soup.name: Fish Cake Soup (Eomuk-guk)
steps: Cut the Korean radish into 2 cm-thick half-moons, fold the fish cake in half and skewer it on a stick or cut it into bite-sized pieces, and slice thinly the green onion.

Put 800 ml of water, the Korean radish, and the anchovy into a pot, and when it comes to a boil over high heat, reduce the heat to medium and boil for 10 minutes to make the broth, then remove the anchovy.
Add the fish cake and the green onion, season with 2 tbsp of soy sauce and minced garlic, and boil for 5 more minutes.
Finish by sprinkling a little black pepper.
tips: Fish cake gets soggy if boiled for too long, so the last 5 minutes is just right.
Adding 1 Cheongyang pepper gives it a refreshing and spicy taste.

fish-cake-stir-fry.desc: A quick side dish made with fish cakes from the fridge.
fish-cake-stir-fry.name: Stir-Fried Fish Cake (Eomuk-bokkeum)
steps: Cut the fish cake into 1cm width strips, blanch in boiling water for 10 seconds to remove excess oil, and cut the onion and carrot into thin strips.
Heat 1 tbsp of cooking oil in a pan heated over medium heat, and stir-fry the onion and carrot for 1 minute.
Add the fish cake, pour in 1.5 tbsp of soy sauce, 1 tsp of sugar, and 3 tbsp (45ml) of water, and stir-fry for 3~4 minutes until the liquid is almost reduced.
